strings.BRA_THENEWORDER_DESC:
Brazil is a land of contrasts: it has a booming economy, but poverty is everywhere. It remains in cold war with the African Reichskommissariats, but is not involved with the OFN embargo against Japan. A state which is a liberal democracy, but where countless remain disenfranchised.

Brazil's economy will continue growing as long as the trade continues, but its politics are on a knife-edge. While Brazil's future looks bright, those in power know that it could all come tumbling down at a moment's notice.

strings.BRA_antarctica.1.d:
“In short, we'll face no meaningful opposition.”

Admiral Rademaker stood in a circle of officers in smart uniforms, huddled around a large map of the frozen continent: Antarctica. Their faces were as bright as the overhead lights. Rademaker worked his jaw. “Can we trust the Americans on this?”

“They've conducted extensive surveillance to reach this conclusion, sir.” The junior officer motioned towards the map. “The Americans are confident the Germans abandoned everything between these longitudes, all the way to the Argentine border.”

“It will be a swift operation, then.”

Rademaker retreated from the circle, stepping towards the windows of the command room of Minas Gerais. The proud flagship of the Brazilian Navy was at his feet, in all its armored glory. Modern aircraft lined its deck, falcons atop the frothing waves. A crew hundreds strong kept the iron behemoth alive, cutting through the expanse of the South Atlantic at its Admiral's behest.

It must be destiny, Rademaker thought, that Germany had fallen into turmoil at the time it did. It would be him, at the head of the great fleet that spread over the horizon, that'd win this next great victory for Brazil. They'd sweep south and provide Brazil with the prestige of an Antarctic territory; punish the Germans after their insults in the Lobster War, and push the Argentines against the ropes.

And for no cost, too. Another medal for Brazil—another medal for himself. He turned to the officers with a faint smile. “Let us not delay in our duty, gentlemen.”
strings.BRA_antarctica.2.d:
Admiral Rademaker arrived at Ritscher Base trailing the first echelon of Brazilian marines. They rushed, guns drawn, towards buildings scorching black amidst the white wasteland.

The only building left standing was a hospital - four walls and a rotten roof. Their rifles poked the bodies on the rows of beds and found limbs frozen stiff—skin in unnatural blue and purple stuck loosely to their bones, thin like the tattered mattresses. To think their comrades had simply left them for dead. Rademaker shuddered at the thought

“We got lucky,” said one of the marines, smiling. “Every German here is dead.”

But casualties came, anyway: two marines were blown back by a minefield around the abandoned radio station; another, just a kid, had his face disfigured by a tripwire bomb. American intelligence was half correct. Though the Germans had abandoned their only major outpost, they had not left it undefended, leaving gifts behind that'd snatch as many Brazilian lives as they could.

Rademaker inspected the charred alleyways, trampling over snow that turned gray with ash. He hadn't anticipated the Germans would opt for a full-scale immolation of the base. This was more than a temporary retreat to resort to such permanent measures, things must have been far worse for them than reported. The admiral watched his men throw frozen German corpses into piles outside the hospital, replenishing the beds with their own injured. They'd have nothing against the cold but the sheets of the dead before them.

The wind whispered in Rademaker's ear as his men huddled together. How would he keep them alive for weeks without appropriate shelter? How long until new supplies arrive? The admiral's mind was blank. Empty and frozen like the miles and miles of ice around them. Though the Germans were gone an enemy remained for them to face, one far deadlier than any soldier...
strings.BRA_antarctica.2.a: The real battle had only just begun.
strings.BRA_antarctica.3.d:
Admiral Rademaker paced about his stateroom feeling subtle vibrations of the waves below hitting his carrier. This whole operation was starting to look like a mistake. The Brazilians had been lucky not to meet many enemy forces in their occupation of the territory. But nature and logistics made powerful enemies in the Antarctic.

Shelter was in short supply, as were shipments of resources. The Americans had offered to help, but Rademaker knew better than to fall for that trap a second time. If he accepted, the Brazilian forces would be made all the more dependent on the United States here in Antarctica. They would want guarantees, assurances that the Brazilians would open a second flank against New Swabia whenever the Germans came knocking again. Given the pitiful state of the Brazilian forces, the Admiral doubted they could hold for long. With such a shortage of supplies and morale, they were barely surviving the weather alone, and winter was fast approaching. No, he needed a backup plan. Retreat home was not an option, but perhaps there was an alternative.

He sat back down at his desk and looked over a map of Antarctica to their east the large mass of German New Swabia loomed over their paltry territory, but to the west there was something far more manageable. The Argentinian claim, sitting ripe and undefended, its commander far too concerned with their feud with Chile and quixotic adventures to be able to resist for long. Rademaker smirked. Leal believed that leading an expedition to The South Pole would make the world respect Argentina's borders. It was almost comically naive to Rademaker. Fame and glory could do little to protect their claim if push came to shove.

Plans were already forming in his head. Not a mere exit strategy, but a conquering exodus that would preserve the prestige of his country and career should worst come to pass. For now, Rademaker would hold his ground...
strings.BRA_antarctica.3.a: But who knows what the future will bring.

strings.BRA_adhemar_moneybags_initialization_tt: The Rouba Mas Faz decision category is now available, which tracks Adhemar's £BRA_adhemar_legacy_texticon legacy and his personal wealth in the £BRA_adhemar_slush_fund_texticon slush fund.
strings.BRA_adhemar_moneybags_info_tt:
For Adhemar de Barros, politics is a simple matter of giving people what they want. Unlike the rotating cast of ideologues and pretenders who have graced Brazil's halls of power in the past, Adhemar is frank about what he wants: fair compensation for the good that he does, preferably in cash.

Adhemar's supporters and his detractors alike have dubbed this policy “rouba mas faz” - steals, but does. As Adhemar works to cement his £BRA_adhemar_legacy_texticon legacy as the President of the people through his reforms and projects, there will no doubt be opportunity to make contributions to his £BRA_adhemar_slush_fund_texticon slush fund.

Lasting, popular, public victories will boost Adhemar's £BRA_adhemar_legacy_texticon legacy, while missteps or scandals can cause it to fall. At the end of his presidency, it will be his £BRA_adhemar_legacy_texticon legacy which determines whether Adhemar's time in office was seen as a success or failure. As for the £BRA_adhemar_slush_fund_texticon slush fund, these untraceable dollars will be put to good use outside the stiff constraints of the bureaucratic apparatus, ensuring the PSP's rightful place in power or perhaps as a personal pension for Brazil's most dedicated public servant.

strings.BRA_adhemaredna_category_description: History does not repeat itself, but it does rhyme. In Brasília, the Palácio do Planalto hosts a shattered mirror of the previous government. Vice President Edna Lott reprises her father's administrative struggle, this time against President Adhemar de Barros. Both are aware of the dangers of a divided executive. Adhemar has two options: he can work with Edna, turning her to an unlikely ally, or he can destroy her. He may find the daughter a more formidable opponent than her father.
strings.BRA_adhemaredna_info_tt:
President Adhemar and Vice President Lott pace around Brasília, following paths well-trodden by the previous administration.

As with the Lott government, decisions that the administration makes will shift the balance of power, and the strength of their relationship will affect how their government weathers a potential crisis. Only time will tell whether it will repeat the mistakes of the past or make new mistakes of its own.
strings.BRA_adhemaredna_bar_tooltip_adhemar_over: President Adhemar's influence is currently overwhelming!

strings.BRA_adhemaredna_remove_edna_desc: Edna's days are limited. For too long has she born a thorn in the side to the government, and now we have clear unrefutable evidence that she is a Judas and must be brought to immediate justice.
strings.BRA_adhemaredna_worsen_relations_desc: Giving the cabinet too much control over their own finances is a mistake - too many opulent banquets and too much overpriced equipment. Adhemar will personally ensure it's used for better things - like lining his pockets.
strings.BRA_adhemaredna_improve_relations_3_desc: The President and Vice President will host a joint press conference where they will outline their strategy to address Brazil's problems.
strings.BRA_adhemaredna_improve_relations_0_desc: Adhemar and Edna will set aside time to speak with visiting foreign diplomats and to attend a banquet in their honor.
strings.BRA_adhemaredna_improve_relations_2_desc: The Presidential cabinet will meet to ensure implementation of the current agenda goes as planned.
strings.BRA_adhemaredna_improve_relations_1_desc: Adhemar and Edna will hear out governors, working in concert to placate their concerns.
strings.BRA_adhemaredna_increase_adhemar_influen: Off-the-books bonuses will be given to civil servants who have been loyal to the President, ensuring their continued support for his agenda.

Former Governor of São Paulo, Adhemar de Barros, has an extensive network of allies all across the city. Adhemar will bring in these political allies to his administration and shore up support for him.
President Adhemar will have his Chief of Staff, Laudo Natel, sit down with members of the military, offering favours and bribes for their continued support.

While the PSP may not be the strongest party in Brazil, it's dominated by Adhemar and acts as his sword and shield. The President will strategize with party leaders to finalize the congressional agenda.
Adhemar will reinforce his position as figurehead of the Brazilian government through a public speech. Edna's presence will not be necessary.
strings.BRA_adhemaredna_increase_edna_influence_: Vice President Edna will hear out the administration's detractors in the PSD and PTB and PSP, reminding them that Adhemar must be fought against.
Bureaucracy is one of the biggest obstacles to solving Brazil's problems. Edna will attempt to persuade and negotiate with members of the cabinet to side with her against Adhemar in meetings.
Corruption is the greatest weakness and largest target that can be used against Adhemar. Edna will hold speeches and rallies calling for a end to corruption in Brazil.
Trade Unions have been longtime supporters of the PTB, so the Vice President will meet with Union leaders to hear out their concerns and undermine Adhemar.

strings.BRA_the_adhemar_presidency_desc:
The Lord be praised, we've made it! The presidency is Adhemar's!

Some comrades were lost through the perils of electoral politics. Vice-presidential candidate Edna Lott has defeated President Adhemar's friend and associate Laudo Natel. Cohabitation with a moralistic left wing Vice-President is likely to restrict President Adhemar's ambitions. That said, it is not yet time to strike.

While we await for Edna Lott's guard to drop down, the President has an ambitious plan to prove his abilities to the voting public. Drawing from his medical training as well as his time in São Paulo politics, Adhemar has had ample experiences with Brazil's dysfunctional medical system. Former President Lott, busy with his lobsters, agrarian reforms, and South Africa, has failed to build on the work done by Kubitschek. The public system is thus vastly underfunded and failing to meet demand. Our reforms will turn this around.

We will focus our attention on the nation's health, to prove that President Adhemar not only steals, he also does!
strings.BRA_setting_up_the_house_of_cards: Setting Up the House of Cards
strings.BRA_setting_up_the_house_of_cards_desc:
No man rules alone. Wise courtiers know their importance to their prince's efforts. Wise princes in turn know the importance of capable courtiers whose allegiance can be guaranteed.

President Adhemar has begun naming ministers, finding advisors and hiring other key officials. Most of the candidates are alumni from São Paulo's school of politics; friends of Adhemar, oftentimes owing a debt to the President... Sometimes literally. These men got things done in São Paulo while keeping the graft to a tolerable level. They will be asked to replicate their efforts in Brasília, starting with helping the President's healthcare blitz.

Loyal as their men may be, not all of them are friends with one another. Many no doubt hold skeletons in their closets. The opposition will be on the lookout for any sign of dissent or corruption within the cabinet. President Adhemar is building a house of cards, and needs to be careful about his next few choices, lest a joker bring down the whole edifice.
strings.BRA_shut_her_out_desc:
Vice-President Edna Lott is determined, ambitious, righteous and believes she is God's gift to the poor Brazilian workers. All character traits that make her wholly unsuited for Brazilian politics, let alone a role within President Adhemar's projects. She is likely to seize the first whiff of corruption as an opportunity to undermine the President. And the presence of the PTB's messiah within any of the President's project is likely to irritate our allies on the right. In a word, Edna Lott is dangerous.

Sidelining her at this early step will ruffle feathers within the PTB. Signaling that we have no intention of giving the Vice-President any power or influence will certainly make her double down on her opposition to Adhemar's presidency. Yet what else can be done? Any scrap of information she retrieves will increase the danger she poses to us. Edna Lott fought us for the vice-presidency. The Lord teaches to forgive our enemies... But He does not begrudge us for sleeping with one eye open when surrounded with danger.
strings.BRA_let_her_in_desc:
Yes, it is true that the relationship between the President and the Vice-President is frosty. But Edna Lott's heart is in the right place, for she truly cares about the fate of society's poorest. Having seen her integrity, dignity, and sound speech, the President will now offer her a chance to be a model of good works.

Working with Edna Lott and the PTB will help make our healthcare bill much stronger. It will help drive a wedge between the old PTB-PSD coalition, and keep our left flank secure. The political cost to this will be opening up our government to attacks from the right wing, especially within the UDN. Assuming the bill goes through, however, this need not be a problem; baiting the UDN into attacking our government over our willingness to work with other parties will make them look callous and cruel once the poorest Brazilians are given healthcare.

The UDN will be put to shame, having nothing evil to say about us and our efforts to help all Brazilians!
strings.BRA_working_with_the_udn_desc:
Going at it alone without the Vice-President's party will require other sources of support. The conservatives of the UDN are leery of our President's populist instincts. Nevertheless they can be convinced to work with us. By integrating Christian institutions into the fabric of the healthcare system as well as through pork barrel spending for various UDN constituencies, we can secure the backing of the conservatives. Many of our enemies on the right criticize government overreach, yet few do not realize how useful it is in securing re-election from grateful voters.

Of course the joyless crow will bitterly oppose this. Yet for all his croaking, Lacerda does not control all of the UDN. Stealing from hist nest will no doubt enrage him. President Adhemar would rather live with a weakened and angry Lacerda than without healthcare reform.
strings.BRA_building_on_kubitscheks_work_desc:
President Kubitschek was a man of too many projects for a single presidency. He no doubt hoped to build upon his basic reforms of healthcare through a second mandate. Unfortunately for him, Kubitschek did not account for the possibility of a newcomer hijacking the PSD's dominant position.

We will make good use of the former President's reforms as well as the nascent healthcare bureaucracy he helped create. The health sector represents among other things a veritable cornucopia of civil service appointments we can use as spoils for friends within the party as well as for corporate lobbyist. By merging industry expertise and resources with loyalists of our party establishment, President Adhemar hopes to build a political structure to last the ages. The house of cards always needs delicate attention, after all.

Let us only pray that Vice-President Lott, overjoyed as she is over healthcare reform, does not realize what we are up to.
strings.BRA_cooperating_with_the_ptb_desc:
As expected, opening the door to Edna Lott has caused another door to close on the right. Many UDN politicians have sulked off, already writing off our healthcare reforms as communist drivel. President Adhemar will not mourn their absence, but will remember to name and shame them once the public is given a new healthcare system.

The PTB have shown themselves surprisingly cooperative after our show of good faith in bringing the Vice-President onboard. Important labour members such as Brizola and Goulart have requested meetings with the President to hash out details. Their requests are likely to be costly, and increase the scope of our healthcare reforms. This is likely to annoy some of our party's backers. They should know better, however; the PSP is a party of doers, not complainers, and President Adhemar is not scared by a little increase of the debt.
strings.BRA_cooperating_with_udn_governors_desc:
Beyond the federal scope of the debate, healthcare reform will need to pass through the various state institutions in order to go into effect.

Most state governors, be they right wing or left wing, jealously guard their prerogatives. We can be assured that the left leaning governor will at least listen to our proposal, no matter how tepid their attitude. However, more conservative states are likely to staunchly oppose our effort. In these governor's view, a national healthcare reform is at odds with the federal nature of our great republic.

President Adhemar must thus set to work convincing UDN aligned governors such as Paraná state's Ney Braga. Thankfully the assistance of the national UDN will be of great help in this endeavor. As will the President's usual combination of charm, cajoling, veiled threats and bribes. One way or another, the conservative states must bend the knee to our efforts, states' right be damned!
strings.BRA_expand_the_ambulance_system_desc:
One of Kubitschek's good ideas within the healthcare ministry was to introduce the age of ambulances to Brazil. Governor of São Paulo at the time, Adhemar built on this trend by building up São Paulo's fleet of motorized ambulances. Now comes the time for the rest of the country to be equipped with ambulances.

Of course, great reforms need not come at great cost. We are to begin a bidding war between the Japanese company Toyota, the American Ford company as well as local Brazilian constructors. The foreigners' attempt to get into our good grace will no doubt enrich the party with kickbacks. Meanwhile friendly local businessmen will receive their share of the contract in return for political goodwill. This way everyone can be a winner, the Brazilian tax payers most of all.
strings.BRA_expanding_the_vaccination_programs_d:
Brazil may be blessed in its geography by its considerable size. Its equatorial position and its vast jungles, however, have brought with them a range of diseases. Too many of our citizens continue to live hobbled by tropical diseases. Many find their life prematurely ended by them.

Saving these citizens is possible through the modern wonder of vaccination. Many illnesses that were once life sentences can now be ended through a simple inoculation. Many Brazilians are not afforded this life changing possibility simply because of the remoteness of their villages.

São Paulo under governor Adhemar saw vast vaccination campaigns. Brazil under President Adhemar must now see the same, a national effort to contain and eliminate preventable diseases. So our national health reform must begin, by a great crusade against the tiniest enemy of all.
strings.BRA_an_unholy_alliance_desc:
The Brazilian political scene has begun boiling over since the so-called 'unholy alliance' has been revealed to all. Members of the conservative opposition have constantly cried out about our alliance with the radical left. Some of our party's members have joined the UDN in their grumbling, openly voicing their opinion that we are caving in to communists and other extremists.

Criticized from all sides, President Adhemar has decided that the safest way through this valley of shadows is straight ahead. By doubling down on our alliance with the radical members of the labour party, our government can get this healthcare bill to the finish line. We must fear no evil, confident in the Lord's will.
strings.BRA_improving_the_central_bureacracy_des:
President Kubitschek's pharaonic ambition required an entire chain of commands of scribes, bureaucrats, and high priests. Thankfully this expanded and strengthened bureaucracy extended to healthcare, where Kubitschek built some improvements. The old President also took some time to streamline as many departments as he could.

Unfortunately, this bureaucracy is in many aspects still overly complicated. We can cut down on the bloat to make the system faster, cheaper, and better integrated with private healthcare firms. In addition, the concentration of power into fewer but more important positions will open many jobs for allies of the party and the President. We can thus leave our mark on the healthcare system for years to come by staffing the bureaucracy with loyal and competent men... No matter their origins.
strings.BRA_convincing_the_senate_desc:
Getting the bill through the Senate will require the help of every ally we can get... As well as quite a few of our enemies' grudging support.

By expanding additional efforts and political capital, President Adhemar will be able to influence one more party to back our efforts in this final stretch before the senate vote. From influencing skeptical UDN members, to securing the unity of the PSP, to obtaining the help of members of the PTB or PSD, this final push will be of great importance to our objective.

The President is not assured success in this venture. Nevertheless as a man of action, he much prefers acting instead of standing still until the final vote in these final hours.
strings.BRA_creating_a_national_public_option_de:
Many accused Adhemar of megalomania when first running for the presidency. Thankfully, our boss cares not for the thoughts of lesser minds, too concerned with others' opinions to carry on with the hard work of governance. After talks with the PTB, President Adhemar plans a project yet unseen in world history. A national public option, aiding the nation's citizens from cradle to grave.

Even within our party, many are now right in the open arguing this policy goes too far, that a 'bolshevization' of healthcare will be a costly blunder. Many provincial governors, especially those aligned to the UDN, are tempesting about the end of the federation, about gross overreach into each state's affair, about Adhemar's descent into corrupt Bukharinism.

The President is convinced to steam ahead. Backed by Edna Lott, President Adhemar knows that this policy is very popular within our party's voters as well as within the PTB's membership. Through this master stroke, President Adhemar will secure his presidency as well as plant the seed of the PTB's collapse into an irrelevant junior partner of our government as left wing voters flock to our banner.
strings.BRA_present_the_bill_desc:
It is all over but the counting. President Adhemar has obtained the backing of all those he could. It is now time to present the bill to the Senado.

Much political prestige rides on this. We can only hope that we've prepared enough.
strings.BRA_celebrating_our_great_victory_desc:
Victory!

The healthcare bill has sailed through legislation without a hitch. President Adhemar has signed it into law in front of assembled journalists and supporters, to wild applause and cheering. We can now celebrate this victory, as well as turn to face the future.

The effects of our victory here will prove to be multi-faceted. Our successful negotiations have amply shown to the political class that for all his quirks and foibles, President Adhemar is a skilled negotiator and one that can be done business with. The passing of the healthcare act will also help sink Lacerda further as our grip on the right is secured, if not through ideological purity, then through popularity. Finally, with our political base energized, we are free to turn toward the economy, in order to enrich Brazil and ourselves.

Vice-President Lott will no doubt monitor our further progress. With the governing party secure, President Adhemar will also be free to turn to his troublesome Vice-President, in due time.
strings.BRA_blame_them_for_its_failure_desc:
Failure! The bill has been strangled in its cradle, as perfidious senate members have turned out in great numbers to block our progress.

This loss has been particularly bitter to President Adhemar by hurting his personal brand. The man elected to steal and do has shown himself incapable of doing. Where does that leave Brazil?

With Lacerda's vultures circling, it is time for us to go on the counter-attack. The situation calls for a fall guy. Unfortunately for our economic minister Barreto, he is to be the scapegoat.

Benedito Manhães Barreto will be sacked for his 'failures'. In his place, President Adhemar will name a new candidate, an old face that everyone knows and respects, our current Chief of Staff, Laudo Natel. Our coalition stabilized, we will be free to move to new projects.
strings.BRA_planning_our_next_steps_desc:
The Palácio da Alvorada has seen a whirlwind of activity of late. Meeting with prominent politicians, with industrialists, with economists. Union leaders brush shoulder with bureaucrats in the corridors of the presidential estate. In the middle of all of this, our President, serving as maestro as Brazil's future is being drawn up.

A South American Las Vegas, where tourists from all over the world come for pleasure and relaxation. A regional economic juggernaut, sitting on modernized infrastructure with an optimized bureaucracy. A political establishment working in concert, anchored around the solidified PSP.

All of these are coming to Brazil, and more. And in between planning meetings, President Adhemar has had a phone call or two to Switzerland. Important to keep track of his secret bank account, of course. President Adhemar always plans for the future.
strings.BRA_eradicate_illiteracy_desc: About 1/3rd of our population, or over 25 million Brazilians, are unable to read or write, or both! This illiteracy crisis is mostly felt in the rural areas, forgotten by the big city bureaucrats that led the urban areas to prosperity while the common Brazilian floundered in the countryside. For far too long, they have been left without the proper tools needed to advance in education and it is quite simply unacceptable that these people continue to be neglected, especially by our government. By beginning a comprehensive education program, we will be able to ensure that these people get the education they deserve, granting them the same opportunities as their fellows in our great cities! And who knows: maybe their newfound education will give them the common sense to vote for us come election season...
strings.BRA_national_school_expansion_program_de: One of the main driving forces to the illiteracy crisis is the severe lack of schools in rural areas and the favelas. In some of these places, up to 3/4ths of the population are completely unable to read and write, let alone have access to the appropriate services to learn! We need to alleviate this issue immediately by pursuing the construction of schools all over Brazil's poorer areas to get these people access to education. After all, it has always been our true goal!
strings.BRA_start_in_amazonas_desc: The vast northern region of Amazonas makes up about 40% of Brazil's total landmass, not to mention the biggest forest in the world! Yet, as we reap the wonderful harvest of its material resources, we have neglected the people that live and work in it. Amazonas is often forgotten and quite underrepresented in national policies as the focus has always been on its resources, yet we must care for its people too. Therefore, we should begin our program here and prove that we shall care for all of our citizens, even in the furthest reaches of our nation. Though, we must temper our financial expectations, as it will no doubt be a monumental expense to provide the region with the necessary schools.
strings.BRA_listen_to_ednas_ideas_desc: Even though it would be more preferable for us to go with an all-PSP program with our education reform, it cannot be denied that Vice President Lott is a lot more experienced in the education sector than us. Edna knows more about the needs of teachers than anyone else in the cabinet, so it would be foolish not to seek out her advice to ensure that our program will succeed... We can also use this opportunity to limit the amount of funds coming out of the treasury to “guarantee” a smooth passing of the bill with the Labor support this will surely shore up.
strings.BRA_maintain_high_standard_desc: The teachers of Brazil work a thankless and frustrating job in educating the youth of our great country. As such, it is of paramount importance that we maintain our high standards by taking various measures to make their jobs more rewarding. We will codify their rights into law, like minimum wage, student relations, career advancement, and more. In addition, we will organize training courses in order to make sure they are up to standard as well as to expand their capabilities upon Edna's advice. Evidently,this can all come when the teachers' unions change their tune from PTB to PSP. Until they're singing about our own Mr. Rouba Mas Faz, they are not getting a single cent from this program.
strings.BRA_pay_raises_for_teachers_desc: Inflation hurts all sectors of our great society, teachers especially. We need to raise their wages to adapt to the change in prices as well as raising their societal standing based on their merits and experience. This will encourage them to continue teaching amidst our economic situation and incentivize others to start educating our youth too. Where will the money for this come from? We needn't worry about it, we'll find a way if anything goes awry...
strings.BRA_help_nordeste_desc: The Nordeste region is where it all began more than 400 years ago, in 1500. It was here the Portuguese landed in Brazil, and it is here where the foundation of the Brazilian nation was laid down in the old capital of Salvador. And now? It is a mostly agricultural region, its once powerful position overtaken by the modern prestige of Brasília. We need to restore the glory the Nordeste once held so proudly, thus we should expand the education program here next with the construction of schools and training of teachers all across the region. While it may not be as resource-rich as the Amazonas, it has the highest number of states and thus the highest number of senators to be elected, which makes it quite important to us. After all, how is a man who cannot read or write supposed to lead and vote?
strings.BRA_fullfil_psp_promises_desc: At the insistence of our Minister of Education, we do not need to come up with any new groundbreaking policy for our reforms; we must only deliver what we promised during campaign season to make the voters happy. While the policies we have chosen to implement are not necessarily the most efficient, what matters the most is that they are the most popular with the general public.
strings.BRA_establish_pilot_agrarian_program_des: One of our biggest promises in our great educational undertaking is the establishment of agricultural schools in three grades: One for rural workers, one for technicians and rural teachers, and lastly, one for agronomists and veterinarians. We will slowly work towards this promise by beginning a pilot program in Centro-Oeste, a mostly agricultural region that had started real development under the administration of Kubitschek. This way, we will not only be able to fulfill our promise and uplift people, but also be able to gain support by finishing what Kubitschek had started there.
strings.BRA_equality_of_state_and_private_educat: Despite our comprehensive educational reforms, this is a great undertaking we cannot hope to accomplish alone. We must abolish the taxation of private schools and institutions, which will encourage their establishment in order to have equality between the public and private education sectors. Conveniently, this will only (positively!) affect the upper and parts of the middle class, allowing us to shore up support from conservatives. What a win for everybody!
strings.BRA_put_the_bill_to_vote_desc: With the bill clearly defined, now comes the true Herculean task: actually pushing the bill through Congress. We will have to work double time on pulling favors and sending out bribes in order to make sure that Adhemar's bill passes at all costs. Its approval will be a significant boost to our popularity, and will above all prove that the man who steals from the people also delivers the most for them!
strings.BRA_renovate_old_schools_desc: While we are building countless new schools, we mustn't get ahead of ourselves and forget about the schools that are already standing. These schools are hot, they're crowded, some of them don't even have proper sanitation. These conditions are appalling and simply unacceptable! We must send appraisers immediately to calculate the cost of renovation and flag the schools that need them the most. Out with the old and in with the new and renewed!
strings.BRA_increase_health_awareness_desc: Our great President Adhemar is, first and foremost, a student of medicine, and he has not forgotten his roots as a doctor. As such, he understands more than anyone that preventing, not curing, is the key to wellness. We will send doctors to schools throughout Brazil to examine the health of the youth, treat any minor ailments they may have, and educate them on basic hygiene and proper nutrition. For a healthier, energized Brazil!
strings.BRA_promote_sport_desc: While being the governor of the glorious State of São Paulo, Adhemar invested quite a remarkable amount of money into sports facilities for schools. Never forgetting where he started, he now seeks to do the same on a national level by providing funds for new basketball courts, new volleyball equipment, new football shoes, you name it! We shouldn't forget that all work and no play makes a dull (and unhealthy!) person; it is known that sports and physical activity makes you live longer, which perhaps might help us make some cuts in future healthcare funding...
strings.BRA_build_dormitories_desc: In all of Brazil, we have but a measly 100,000 university students according to our latest estimates. To mitigate this awkward number, Vice President Lott proposes to build cheap lodging for university students to encourage people to take up higher studies, as well as reduce transportation costs for those ambitious men and women that seek to discover their talents in our esteemed academies. They may not be the most luxurious of accomodations, but something is better than nothing!
strings.BRA_no_child_left_behind_desc: While increasing the quantity of students through ease of educational access is paramount to our program, the quality of our young students is also crucial in our program's success. One can hardly expect a malnourished student to excel at his studies when he is far too busy worrying about his next meal, or expect a disabled student to even keep up when they are neglected and ignored by public institutions. Therefore, we must ensure that everyone gets a free, adequate meal at school so that poor students will not be disadvantaged in their pursuits. Furthermore, we shall arrange special classes for the disabled, with teachers specializing to accommodate their needs with absolute care and inclusivity.
strings.BRA_changes_to_curriculum_desc: An even bigger problem in rural areas than the lack of primary education is secondary education: a rural child who does manage to start primary schooling will rarely ever step foot in a junior high school classroom. While our new schools are large enough to accommodate both primary and secondary students, in older facilities we must run calculations and introduce “double-shift schooling”, which will provide to anyone who wants the chance of education. In addition to this, Adhemar, ever the polyglot, has ordered that university students be obliged to learn a foreign language. Whether it be Romance, Germanic, or even Japanese, Adhemar himself knows many languages and understands the benefits of being able to converse with foreigners in their mother tongue. The better we understand the peoples of abroad, the better benefits we could gain.
strings.BRA_university_scholarships_desc: Of course, Adhemar himself was once a student, and the hardships of studying are not lost on him. From exam cramming, to material discussion, to quizzing; graduation requires an unimaginable amount of time dedicated to studying. As such, our university students must be able to dedicate all their time to their courses instead of diverting their attention to trying to make ends meet. Excelling students will be given money in the form of scholarships to help them focus entirely on their education, and no one can say we're using an envelope system to ensure that their votes, or families, have gone to us, of course...
strings.BRA_provide_modern_facilities_desc: While Brazil will obviously never be able to catch up to the likes of Guangdong, at least in terms of innovation, we can still work towards achieving their prestige and get somewhere better. The logical first step will be to modernize our existing research facilities and establish new ones in order to make our tertiary education on par with the modern world's trends and on par with nations such as Australia and Canada. Who knows! We might even make it to the world's best at this rate.
strings.BRA_put_religion_back_at_the_proper_plac: As it stands, theology is an optional educational subject. How blasphemous! Our youth deserve to be privy to the knowledge of their place in God's Good Heaven, therefore we will make theology an obligatory class in primary and secondary education. It does not matter if you are a Christian, a Muslim, or, God forbid, an Atheist; You should and will know of our Lord's eternal grace and salvation.
strings.BRA_ensure_freedom_of_teaching_desc: We promised teachers more possibilities and flexibility in their way of teaching, and we have no intention of leaving promises unfulfilled! Teachers will no longer have to abide by a dogmatic standard, for instead they will be able to use holistic approaches that they feel would be the most effective for their pupils. As long as they follow the curriculum, then we have no qualms in the way they teach our impressionable youth.
strings.BRA_supply_textbooks_desc: We need to update the old textbooks currently in use to keep our nation's pupils up to date with all the newest breakthroughs in science, humanities, and even politics. We need to make sure that outdated textbooks are replaced immediately with newer ones, that they are free by the abolishment of scientific textbook tariffs, and, most importantly, that our great President Adhemar is portrayed favorably in each and every one of them...
strings.BRA_deal_with_adult_illiteracy_desc: While we work towards eliminating illiteracy among our youth, we cannot forget about the older generations who have unfortunately gone their entire lives without being able to read letters or even write them. As suggested by Vice President Lott and the PTB, we ought to utilize Paulo Freire's “pedagogy of liberation” method to advance adult literacy rates as effectively as possible. The method revolves around encouraging dialogue between teachers and students to drum up interest and challenge the status quo. With this method, 300 sugarcane workers were able to achieve full literacy in just 45 days! We will replicate this great success on a national scale by seeking out educators willing to organize free classes for the illiterate adults, for the wisdom of the old shall not go to waste! Not under President Adhemar's sharp gaze.
strings.BRA_brasil_numero_uno_desc:
Our education system has long suffered from the twin pains of underfunding and disorganization. But following President Adhemar's comprehensive set of reforms, the education system has rapidly expanded and improved. This will prove to be a solid foundation for the Brazil of the future - one whose minds stand shoulder to shoulder alongside the great powers of the world.

Only one step remains towards us truly making the dream of this Brazil a reality remains. If we seek to stand at the top, we must learn from those standing there already. Foreign experts will be paid to come to Brazil and lay out a plan for an entirely new education system - new courses, methods of teaching, and a set of high expectations will be the cornerstones of the new Brazilian education system.
strings.BRA_we_are_on_the_right_way_desc:
Data from our polling sources across Brazil have been collected and the verdict is in: our illiteracy programs have been a total victory for President Adhemar and the PSP! A greater percentage of our nation's youth are enrolled in primary, secondary, and tertiary education than ever before, ensuring that our children will be the brightest and most talented of all previous generations, guaranteeing an economic boom in a matter of years. Second, illiteracy rates are dropping in record time for both children and adults, ensuring that they can take jobs in more areas than just rural farm labor!

Most respondents credit Adhemar and the PSP for this success and we can only assume that they will reward the PSP in the coming elections. May the good times never end.
strings.BRA_weve_got_to_keep_on_moving: We've Got to Keep On Moving
strings.BRA_weve_got_to_keep_on_moving_desc:
Brazil is a vast country, vast in its variety of situations some great and some less so. One of Brazil's greatest ills and shames is its vast wealth disparity among its citizens. Thus, giving Brazil the infamy that comes with being considered a “poor” nation. And no one, absolutely no one, is more aware of this than Brazil's current President, Dr. Adhemar de Barros.

This is indeed the very exact reason why he is the foremost believer in the envelope system. For it is indeed unquestionably the most efficient method of social welfare in Brazilian politics. Where the citizen gets a basic allowance according to his needs. The fact that some might call this a “populist electoral bribe” or even point out that the economic results it might bring are “questionable” is considered nonsense to Adhemar and his administration, for no matter what poverty shall be eradicated in Brazil, no matter the cost!
strings.BRA_help_rural_workers_desc:
Dr. Adhemar is above all things a conscious man. He is conscious of his fatherland and its people, and more importantly, conscious of the problems that afflict them. And, unlike his predecessors, he will not provide half measures to solve them. For years the noble cause of the establishment and enlargement of the rights and benefits of the Brazilian working man has been championed by successive presidential administrations.

However, they have only succeeded in aiding the urban industrial workers of Brazil, while leaving the rural agricultural workers to the same old condition of exploitation and poverty. But they need not to worry, for the rural workers of Brazil have no better friend than President Adhemar de Barros. For one of his new bold reforms shall to extend the present working rights and regulations legislature, including the right to unionize, to all Brazilian rural workers. Brazil's historical wrongs shall be finally righted. And if President Adhemar does it while stealing the thunder from the PDC there is nothing wrong with that.
strings.BRA_adhemar_agrarian_reform_desc:
It may be hard, but sometimes one must be honest with oneself and that rule also applies to President Adhemar, for while his agrarian reform bill corrects regional imbalances, it is already opposed by oligarchs. If he were to try to do a radical agrarian reform (which would require constitutional reform to make payment in bonds for land possible) he shall totally lose their support.

Thus, his administration shall stick with payment in cash as stated in Brazil's constitution to appease everyone. However, he shall be a bit creative with that, as the amount of money needed for such a reform is unfortunately too big and he shall be in need of some of it also for his other goals. So, he will start expropriations in distant regions, where there are small groups of isolated villages or enough literate voters to be swayed, then show that on TV, newspaper, and radio, then proceed to repeat that before every election/once a year. Cheap and Popular the best kind of solution in the eyes of President Adhemar de Barros.
strings.BRA_we_just_want_more_and_more: They Just Want More and More
strings.BRA_we_just_want_more_and_more_desc: It is done! President Adhemar may now rest easy for the Brazilian gordian knot that was the Agrarian Reform is a Fait Acompli. The Brazilian people can rest easy that indeed the Fatherland's greatest son Dr. Adhemar de Barros is always on their side. But in this, no man's land that is the tropical Brazilian fatherland rest in political terms is something only reserved for the dead, unfortunately. For he must now move on to another pressing issue affecting the Brazilian farmer, the supply of fertilizers for Brazilian agriculture. For if that is assured, the administration shall be able to expand Brazil's agriculture into worse soils and increase its productivity to never seen proportions, which hopefully should again increase President Adhemar's approval rate in the Brazilian countryside.
strings.BRA_use_old_allys_experience_desc: One of the most important life lessons President Adhemar de Barros has learned over the many illustrious and controversial years of his career as a Brazilian politician is that most of the time if not always it is better to be safe than sorry. Thus, by the logic of this lesson he shall resolve the fertilizer supply issue. After all, both the United States and Canada are both nearer to Brazil than the other providers so the supply lines would be shorter. And after all, why should Adhemar be the President that broke the long history of profitable trade relations between Brazil and the United States? No, the Adhemar Administration shall not break that historic relationship, it shall rather strengthen it and expand it to areas not foreseen before, proving that the OFN has no better trading partner in South America than Brazil and its genius leader President Adhemar de Barros.
strings.BRA_check_the_assets_of_new_friend_desc: If there is something that President Adhemar has learned, and learned well, throughout his long and controversial career it is that in politics and life it is never good to limit your number of friends. Thus, why should his Administration limit itself to having only the United States as its leading commercial partner, especially if it doesn't benefit Brazil? Therefore, following its lesson why not seek better options? And there is no better option than reaching our good friend Hermann Josef Abs and one of his companies, IG Farben, through the German ambassador. During WW1 Germany was cut off from the supply of Chilean nitrates, which forced them to invent new methods to produce fertilizers, Haber-Bosch process, made it available for Germany to produce nitrates on their own and helped to increase nitrogen fertilizer production. So President Adhemar shall seek his new friends and check what they can offer Brazil.
strings.BRA_expand_ministry_of_agriculture_desc: When it comes to further fulfil his goals in the realm of agriculture, President Ahdemar fully knows that he must take the herculean task of reforming the whole of the Brazilian Ministry of Agriculture, from top to bottom. And the list of his goals is indeed an extensive one: First there is the creation of services to guide the work of irrigation and reforestation, Second there are massive infrastructure efforts in the clearing of rivers and the building of canals, Third there is starting intimate coordination between technical service stations assistance and the Agricultural Research Institutes, Fourth there is the installation of regional and municipal services which are intended for the mechanization of agricultural work, And finally there is the immediate organization of the real estate registry. Many goals to be reached, and they shall indeed be reached, and as always when it comes to Adhemar their cost shall not be considered.
strings.BRA_irrigation_channels_in_nordeste_desc: President Adhemar de Barros wasn't born yesterday, so both he and his administration aren't blind to one of the biggest problems that afflict Brazil, the issue of droughts in the Northeast, a problem that is as old as Brazil itself. Thus. to solve it he has come up with the most modern and efficient solution possible. His administration shall drastically expand the irrigation system in Brazil's Northeast by using modern automatic sprinkler systems with the aim to make it cover the entire region! When it comes to the matter of the poor quality of the soil in the Northeast, to solve that his administration shall deliver new tools and machines to every farmer! No matter what, the Adhemar de Barros Presidency shall be renowned for its popular ad modern policies!
strings.BRA_combatting_crop_pests_desc:
The issue of pestilence hindering crops is as historic and ancient that God himself used it against the Egyptians. And if someone knows his history that someone is President Adhemar de Barros. Luckily for Brazil that isn't the only area where he is knowledgeable. He is fully aware that Brazil's vast crop fields are unfortunately infested by numerous types of pests. Even more Luckily for Brazil's farmers, the Adhemar Administration has a solution to their problem.

Thus, to solve it the Adhemar Administration shall deliver pesticides to farmers throughout Brazil, and in the unique cases where crops are infected by more damaging pathogens a more radical solution shall be used, that one being the total exclusion of infected zones and burning them down, particularly those infected by citrus canker. May the people know that even problems of biblical proportions are no match to Adhemar's genius solutions.
strings.BRA_social_security_reform_desc:
A nation can be considered extremely lucky when its leader is highly in tune with its people. And conscious of their needs and woes. Thus, Brazil is very lucky to have Dr. Adhemar de Barros, for no one is more conscious of the issues that afflict the Brazilian people than him. Especially when it comes to the issues facing Brazil's social security system. His administration is fully aware of its overly complicated structure which gets even more complicated when one considers that it is under the jurisdiction of different institutes.

But what makes a conscious leader isn't only knowing about the problems, but also solving them., Thus, the Adhemar administration shall make a system for all under one single National Social Security Institute, which shall expand access to social security to levels never seen before.
strings.BRA_minimum_pension_desc: President Adhemar is many things, be it “wise”, “charismatic” or even, according to many female voters in Brazil, “very charming”. But, above all, President Adhemar is a conscious and caring person, and he cares most of all about the problem of retired people in Brazil, who unfortunately suffer from being dependent on the help of their families. Well, no more! Thanks to the Adhemar administration, from now on a minimum pension will be established and it will be equal to the minimum wage, so that every hard-working citizen should be able to have a dignified old age after retirement, provided that they pay regular dues to the Brazilian government, of course.
strings.BRA_guaranteed_maternity_leave_desc: The relationship between President Adhemar de Barros and his VP Edna Lott can't be described as the most peaceful or amenable. Both hold a very fierce distaste for the other. Adhemar dislikes Edna since she is a monument to two things, he hates above all, the “Varguist” establishment he wants to replace, and the new left-wing type of “progressive” politics. But even he must admit that sometimes she has good ideas. Using her plans from time to time is very helpful in consolidating PSP's support among women. Thus, her idea for a maternity leave law should encourage more population growth, which will look so nice on graphs for the PSP's next electoral campaign!
strings.BRA_labor_courts_in_big_cities_desc: While Brazil as a country has a lot to thank Dr. Getúlio Vargas for in terms of the fairly good labor laws he created during his long administration, enforcing them is another matter entirely. And as his true successor, President Adhemar de Barros and his PSP government will right the wrongs of the pacts, plug the legal holes in the current legislation, and continue on the long road of progress that Vargas opened for the Brazilian nation. In this way, a labor court will be established in every state capital to protect Brazilian citizens from corporate greed and under the protection of the PSP.
strings.BRA_hospices_for_old_workers_desc: President Adhemar de Barros is a man of many well-known descriptions, which do not need to be repeated for brevity's sake, and amongst these many descriptions, the one that many people say encapsulates his essence as an individual the most is that of a “Man of the People”. And as a man who hasn't forgotten his humble roots, he is conscious of his fellow people's needs and woes. Especially those of the old workers, who are often suffering from many issues after years of hard work, some of them have a really short time on earth due to incurable diseases. Thus. to ensure they will pass out with dignity, the Adhemar Administration shall start building new hospices, so no one will be left to spend the last months of life alone and in poverty.
strings.BRA_the_shield_against_inflation_desc: There are many ways one could describe President Adhemar de Barros, amongst those many illustrious and famous definitions is that of a Wise man. And as a very knowledgeable man who is fully aware of the ways of the world, there is no greater economic evil than inflation. This, the greatest woe of the Kubitschek government is still afflicting the Brazilian nation and hurting the wallets of the middle and lower classes. Thus, to deal with this issue, the Adhemar Administration shall use a simple solution, total automatic indexation of wages. Thanks to this, our voters should be safe from inflation and Brazil's development should continue onwards without obstacles.
strings.BRA_increase_of_unemployment_benefits_de:
Every Brazilian deserves a job - but many still are unable to get one, be it for health reasons or because they simply cannot find one yet. In a normal situation, some of those who oppose us would argue that increasing subsidies for the unemployed would be far too expensive and inflate our balloon economy, but we are not in normal circumstances. As per our efforts, the number of employed has significantly increased, and naturally, the unemployed have decreased; increasing benefits to those who need it won't make any dent in our budget, no matter how anyone looks at it.

With a strong subsidy program for everyone, our march for progress will take one hundred more steps forward!
strings.BRA_money_for_our_defenders_desc:
“Oh, you, soldier of Brazil's defense, whether in the sky, the sea, or on the fields: Accept this loving kiss from the aggrandized Brazil that exalts your value.”

Twenty years ago, thousands of our men were sent to war to defend our freedom from the wretched fascists in Europe, and we have yet to give them the proper acknowledgment that they so much deserve. To make up for our ignorance, veterans of the war will be given priority in our healthcare system, free public transport in all of the country, and an increase in their retirement pensions! With their lives guaranteed, we also gain new allies in the crusade for progress!
strings.BRA_critical_support_to_state_apparatus_:
Brazil cannot be modernized if the people who control it aren't working towards it. There remains much to be done in our bureaucratic agencies, which are filled with men whom we cannot trust. For a new Brazil, expanding our control in the many agencies and appointing our trusted experts to help conduct plans for a good goal is a must.

If those people don't work enough to help fulfill the modernization of our sacred land blessed by God, then we fire them and replace them with those willing to work with us.
strings.BRA_finalize_works_in_congresso_desc: This bill cannot fail, for it will be one that could guarantee our hold in the government for the years to come. Whatever resources we have to ensure votes in congress, we shall use it. Who cares about what a random nobody economist has to say about how we spend our money? If we can pass our reforms without conflict, we should only worry about the economy later.
strings.BRA_healthcare_initiatives_desc: Who's better to decide what's best for our healthcare if not our leader, Dr. Adhemar? He spent his youth studying medicine and attaining expertise in the field. Now it's time we give every hospital in the country a piece of the knowledge from our President, making all of them effective and innovative. Thus, pouring more money into the pocket of our doctors will be the assurance of their companionship in the march for progress.
strings.BRA_prevention_over_treatment_desc:
We have a long way to go in fully reforming our healthcare system, and while re-structuring reactive medicine is a must, we need to put a lot of effort into developing preventive medicine.

Every year, workers around the country will be examined by our own sponsored doctors by taking blood tests, teeth check, and height and weight measurements to ensure they are healthy and ready to go to work in our beautiful country.
strings.BRA_kill_malaria_desc: Before he was one of Brazil's greatest political figures and leaders President Adhemar de Barros was a medical Doctor. And as a very knowledgeable Doctor, Adhemar fully knows that in a tropical country such as Brazil there is no greater pathogenic evil than malaria. Thus, to him it's inadmissible that in recent years malaria was detected in all Brazilian states besides Rio Grande do Sul, so to get rid of it his Administration shall spray DDT on the walls inside the houses in entire Amazonas and in zones of infection in eastern Brazil and continue to use chloroquine to treat febrile cases.
strings.BRA_anti_alcoholism_campaigns_desc: If there is a man on this earth in general, and on Brazil in particular, who wasn't born yesterday, that man certainly is President Adhemar de Barros. He is a man who above all knows all the ways of this world, both good and wicked. He is fully aware that alcohol causes more issues than all other stimulants together, violence, brain damage, and liver destruction are only top of the mountain. Thus, it is his will that his administration makes the ministry of health cooperate with the Church to launch a nationwide campaign for abstinence and finance it with a slight, nearly invisible increase of excise for alcohol.
strings.BRA_uncover_secrets_of_mind_desc: As a very knowledgeable man of the world, which President Adhemar de Barros surely is, he knows that psychiatry has in recent times many interesting breakthroughs. One example is Deinstitutionalization, an idea that has some followers in Italy and USA, that thanks to new psychiatric drugs (like Chlorpromazine) and changing the way we treat patients, we can help the mentally ill return and fully integrate into society. Thanks to this solution his administration can not only make our psychiatry innovative but also reduce the number of beds in asylums so it will be able to reduce its budget spending.
strings.BRA_oncologys_time_to_shine_desc: It does not need to be repeated, for the outstanding genius of Brazilian President Adhemar de Barros is at this point an undeniable fact for everyone, thus his knowledge about the most recent scientific discoveries isn't a surprise either. He is fully aware that with the discovery of DNA, oncology is on its way to achieving new levels of possibilities, that's why his administration will make sure it will have access to the newest machines to conduct research on their own, including the determination of DNA's structure. In addition to that, his administration shall upgrade Brazil's possibilities regarding radiotherapy, which achieved tremendous progress, that's why it will import a huge amount of linear particle accelerators to make Brazilian oncology up to date with the world.
strings.BRA_cheap_drugs_desc: There is no need to be repeated how deep the bonds of kinship and understanding go between President Adhemar de Barros and the Brazilian people. And as a man who fully knows his people just like the palms of his own hands, he is aware that the accessibility to medicine is a problem that afflicts the Brazilian people deeply. Thus, to make access to absolutely necessary medicines broad, his administration shall abolish all customs duties on them and increase the imports to make sure Brazil's citizens can cure themselves for an affordable price. So that in the end when they go to the ballot box they know that if they were cured of their respective maladies they only have the PSP and the Adhemar Administration to thank.
strings.BRA_higher_salaries_for_our_protectors_d:
Before Dr. Adhemar de Barros was one of, if not the greatest presidents Brazil has ever had, he was a lowly doctor. And as a man who is indeed extremely proud of his professional background, he is fully aware that while being a doctor or nurse gives certainly quite a huge amount of prestige in Brazilian society, that's still not enough.

Thus, he feels that it is his personal mission to try to give new incentives to encourage the next generations to take part in this great mission. The greatest doctor of Brazil, Adhemar Pereira de Barros will personally make sure Brazil's personnel gets the decent amount of money they rightfully deserve.
strings.BRA_yet_another_victory_desc: There is a fact that cannot be denied by anyone standing on Brazilian soil, and that fact is that only the good old PSP truly cares about the people. No political party has improved the life of the average Brazilian as much as the glorious PSP once it reached the government. And if the PSP is more powerful than ever it is all thanks to Vargas' rightful heir and Brazil's greatest President, Dr. Adhemar de Barros. Thanks to him agriculture is more efficient than ever, social security is finally giving real help and healthcare is becoming innovative. If Brazil is finally reaching the final stop on the road toward progress then it can only thank the great man that lead it there, President Adhemar de Barros.
strings.BRA_diagnose_the_military_desc: The first thing any good doctor should do when faced with a particularly challenging patient is to, of course, examine them thoroughly and make the proper diagnosis. Therefore, we ought to call in the military for a check-up and diagnose its issues as well as decide a course of treatment in how it will operate after Lott. Our control - or actually... the State's control on the military - should be strengthened in order to make sure no prior conditions should make an unexpected come back in the form of a coup, as well as make sure we can keep up Dr. Adhemar's prescription should someone else be in office...
strings.BRA_fund_our_allies_in_esg: Fund Our Allies in the ESG
strings.BRA_fund_our_allies_in_esg_desc: The Sorbonne faction within the Escola Superior de Guerra are pragmatists at heart, so it should be no surprise that appeasing them is something akin to giving a child new toys to play with. We will make contact with our allies within the ESG to inform them of a new budget that will see an increased stream of funds towards their department, for use as they see fit. Guns, Artillery, Tanks, whatever is required to ensure their continued support against internal and external threats.
strings.BRA_utilize_envelope_system_desc:
Whilst Kruel is busy cooking up a list of generals we can trust to work alongside us rather than against us, we shall handle the more... unofficial side of things.

It's often thought that the military life is a thankless one, where regimen and routine supersede personal pleasure. While this is true to an extent, it should only be proper to reward the most senior of these military men with these... pleasures. We will shower them with all the drinks, drugs, parties, cars, women and money their hearts will desire, all from a brown envelope on their desk. Certainly a base way to secure support, but an effective one nonetheless.
strings.BRA_start_true_modernization_desc:
In typical Adhemar fashion, we have diagnosed the army's problems and laid the foundations for our proposed solutions. Now we can begin to implement them, starting with one of the first items on our agenda; getting new equipment. Our military is still using guns, tanks, and munitions from over a decade ago, some of which are barely functional.

Not only would an upgrade make the army better prepared for actual conflict, it would give the generals some shiny new toys to show off in a parade. Plus, a line of troops guarding the border with a brand new set of weapons ought to make the perfidious Argentine think twice before starting anything funny.
strings.BRA_kitten_desc:
If the sight of 60,933 tonnes of pure, undistilled naval might does not bring a tear to the eye, then how can one truly call themselves a true Brazilian patriot?

The Kitty Hawk-class aircraft carrier is a product of American ingenuity and technological progress. Big, beautiful, and lovingly crafted in dockyards across the states, the Americans have kindly agreed to sell us one. The impact of this cannot be understated, for the presence of even one 'kitten' is enough to secure Brazilian aerial and naval dominance across the southern Atlantic Ocean.

Marinha do Brasil, protegendo nossas riquezas, cuidando da nossa gente!
strings.BRA_red_baron: Red Baron of the Southern Seas
strings.BRA_red_baron_desc:
Who doesn't love an aircraft carrier? Better yet, who doesn't love an aircraft carrier that has successfully helped bring down an empire?

The Manfred von Richthofen class of aircraft carrier is the result of German work ethic and design. A continuation of the Graf Zeppelin carrier that was used during the Second World War, its history is one of success; after all, it was the Graf Zeppelin carriers that helped the Germans invade Britain during Operation Sealion. Hopefully a situation similar to that will never come to pass. But it never hurts to be prepared, eh?
strings.BRA_specters_desc:
Like a swarm of angry bees, the Spectres blast across the sky, reigning death upon Brazil's enemies.

The F110 jet fighter is one of the Ianques' most modern inventions. Reaching speeds of up to 1,604 miles per hour and able to carry around 18,000 pounds, these jets are a gateway to a whole new world of aerial combat. The Argentinians, the Marzists, and the Paraguayan Nazis - all of our foes will be cowering in their boots when they hear the shriek of the Spectres above their heads!
strings.BRA_messerchmitts_desc:
The same angels of death that once bombed Europe into the stone age will now be flying above Brazil - not to destroy, but to protect.

As the staple of the Luftwaffe, the Messerschmitt is known and feared across the world following the German victory of the war. France, Britain, Russia, and most of the old world has tasted their fiery wrath. And once we have purchased them, our foes will know that same fear as we show that we are ready and prepared for Totalen Krieg.
strings.BRA_train_with_ofn_desc: As Adhemar has said, what Brazil needs from the United States is not money, but technical experience. The fine gentlemen running the OFN are some of the greatest military minds currently alive, running one of the most powerful armies on the planet. And as our closest ally, it would be amiss of us to not send our men and generals over, so that they can learn from the best and bring what they've learnt back here.
strings.BRA_restore_young_turks_desc: Way, way back, when the world was less hot and the attitudes were more congenial, there would be a contingent of our officers sent to Germany to put head-to-pickelhauben with the finest German Imperial Officers to swap strategy. Truly, these were great times. And whilst certain regrettable circumstances came about that prevented us from continuing it, the time is right for us to once again send our men to Germania so they learn discipline, tactics, and efficiency with the German elite. Auf wiedersehen, gentlemen!
strings.BRA_enforce_conscription_desc: We do find ourselves with quite the conundrum when it comes to the issue of conscription. While yes, it is mandatory for every man in Brazil upon turning 18, conscription rates have still been steadily declining year by year. This cannot stand - it is vital for every man to know what it is to serve in the army. We will remind the public of this by hiring more recruiters, as well as telling the police to be more... active, in reminding people of what happens in defying Brazilian law.
strings.BRA_destroy_the_red_threat_desc: Disturbing reports have been cropping up around Araguaia, informing us of steadily growing communist influence in the region. If we do not immediately throw everything we have at this canker, it will quickly overwhelm the body. Troops will be deployed to the Amazon and they will be given every right necessary to stamp. Them. Out. These revolutionary maniacs have no place, and if they want 'normal' communism? The PCB is right there.
strings.BRA_monitor_the_dissent_desc:
It is always inevitable in the military - or indeed, any other large, influential institution - that there will be dissent within the lower ranks. Brazil is no different. In our case, a clique of sergeants, corporals, and other fresh-faced dissenters are proving to be a very troublesome roadblock in allowing the army to run efficiently.

While nowhere near as much of a danger to Brazil's stability as the Communist insurgents, these snot-nosed know-it-alls who cannot seem to properly register how the army works are compromising both our respectability and our ability to operate. It's high time we put them in their place. Thankfully, we have a spy in their ranks, who is willing to do just what we need to outmanoeuvre them...
strings.BRA_supervise_constitutionalists_desc:
Even after he has been removed from the Presidency, Henrique Teixeira Lott continues to find ways to be a thorn in our side. Since 1955 at the very least, his little gang of Constitutionalists have dominated the military high command, unduly using the military as a blunt rod to enforce his will where it was unwelcome.

Adhemar was never going to allow this to stand, of course. Now that a PSP government is in power, we can finally afford to put these bastards in their place. Every known member of Lott's clique is to be heavily scrutinized, being placed under a programme of constant surveillance and observation. That way, we will know if they consider doing anything stupid, and can therefore take the steps to prevent it.
strings.BRA_exercito_social_progressista_desc:
Some may claim that our changes to the army have done nothing to quash the politicization of the army. That, instead of removing it, we have simply grafted our own influence onto the military and used it to our own advantage. We truly respect the opinion of these people. However - they are wrong.

Anyone with half a brain can see that we have brought something to the army that most before us never could; pride. Our courageous allies have taken the place of the parasites who sat there previously, and our men can serve happily knowing that their comrades are free of communist sympathies. That is what we have brought back to the military, and by God are we proud. We shall organize a grand parade across the streets of Brasília, to ensure that our soldiers are aware of one thing - that Brazil is a nation that loves her troops!
strings.BRA_meet_with_almirante_alvaro_desc:
America, Germany, and Japan have conquered the atom and weaponised the sun. The rest of the world kneels before these three titans, bending to their whims - for they are holding the Sword of Damocles above us. Imagine how it must feel to hold such power. To have such total and inescapable influence.

Well, some men in Brazil have dared to dream of that.

Enter Admiral Álvaro Alberto da Motta e Silva. Vice-admiral of the Brazilian Navy and one of the brightest minds in the country. Álvaro has been one of the key advocates for the development of a Brazilian nuclear programme for years now, and if anyone knows what is needed to pursue this white whale, then it is him. Invite him to the Planalto - there is much to discuss.
strings.BRA_find_uranium_and_tools_for_nuclear_p:
Uranium is the key to unlocking the mystery of the atom. Unfortunately, while Brazil has enough of it for the beginning of a project, we are not rich enough in the material to be entirely self-reliant - and that is without even thinking about the amount of specialised equipment that would be needed to properly make use of the stuff.

Thus, if we want to get this project off the ground, we will need to find these resources somehow. There are three main potential suppliers across the globe that could possibly be willing to sell us some of their materials, but this will come at a cost. Time for us to doff our caps and swallow our dignity, because begging may be neccesary.
strings.BRA_manhattan_20_desc:
It was in a squash court in America that the first nuclear reactor was built, and their competence in harvesting nuclear power has only developed from there. The United States has been a pioneer in the field for years, and while they may have developed their nuclear project too late to truly turn the tide of the Second World War, it does not make their achievements any less impressive.

Thus, as a nation so competent and already amenable to our interests, it would only make sense to approach them with this deal. We will need to be careful in who we choose, however. Americana is a jealous mistress - and she does not take kindly to us cavorting with other powers.
strings.BRA_deepen_ties_with_australia_desc:
Why bother tethering ourselves to one of the superpowers when we can simply seek a partnership with another up-and-coming power instead? Australia is a country rich in both uranium and the technical know-how necessary to make proper use of the mineral. As a deal with the Australians would be based more on mutual cooperation rather than geopolitical power brokering, a relationship with them would be substantially less domineering than a relationship with Germany or the Americans.

However, as appealing as this notion sounds, we must be aware that the bill we will be required to foot would be much heftier than otherwise. Nonetheless, there is no price tag too high for Brazilian sovereignty, and we will press on.
strings.BRA_hello_hermann_desc:
Werner Heisenberg was one of the greatest scientific minds of the century. It was thanks to him and the ingenuity of other German scientists that the Reich was able to propel itself to the status of a global power, trampling American dreams of global hegemony into the ground.

While some aspects of the National Socialist regime may disagree with us, it is a simple fact that the Germans know their way around a nuke. Thus, we shall continue to pursue our policy of rapprochement with the Germans by approaching Hermann Josef Abs to supply us with the materials for our nuclear programme.
strings.BRA_construct_facilities_in_para_desc:
All the puzzle pieces are on the table, now we need only put them together. We are closer than ever before to unlocking the power of the atom, and by God, will we have it. The first order of business is to make proper use of our materials - we will begin the construction of an enrichment plant in Pará, alongside future nuclear testing sites.

Of course, as the development of this programme is a high priority to the President, we can spare no expense. This will be an all hands on deck project, with the military sent in to oversee the project to assure that everything goes swimmingly - we wouldn't want any dodgy dealings to sabotage something this significant, after all.
strings.BRA_test_our_new_possibilities_desc:
The time has come. Hours of slaving away negotiating with foreign powers, managing logistics, and draining to their very limit has produced not only one, but two nuclear warheads. The PSP has always been a party of dreamers, and today those dreams become a reality. We hold a power so great that it is impossible to ignore. So, why bother keeping it hidden?

We have the testing sites in Pará. The world's eyes are on us. Brazil will today test one of her nukes, christening herself as the fifth global power. May our enemies tremble in fear and our allies thank their lucky stars that we are on their side, for we have mastered the power of the atom.

All that's left to do is to push up your sunglasses and watch the fireworks.
strings.BRA_keep_it_secret_desc:
It is done. In the shadows of Pará, we have forged a weapon worthy of the gods. We have assembled our first nuclear warhead, and if the scientists are correct, it is a properly functional one. Our hard work has been rewarded with prestige beyond our wildest dreams.

And yet, this endeavor has not come cheaply. In the slightest. By possessing even one warhead, we are now a nuclear power, holding the ability to unleash devastation upon the world at a whim.
