Is that not what we set out to do in the first place? So by that logic, we needn't bother throwing any more money at this programme anymore. Adhemar will be able to find a much better use for the cash elsewhere, anyway. Champagne, anyone?
strings.BRA_adhemar_the_heisenberg_of_brazil_des:
They said it couldn't be done. “An empty promise,” they called it. “Populistic nonsense with no bearing in reality,” they said. They doubted us, and refused to place their trust in us. Well, they were wrong. And now look at us. Brazil, a nuclear power! Who would've thought it a few years ago?

Adhemar did. Once again, the man who steals and delivers has delivered Brazil one of the greatest gifts she could possibly receive. He will be remembered as the father of our nation's nuclear power - the Brazilian Prometheus, if you will. While some minor advisors like Admiral Álvaro may have helped him along the way, this was yet another example of Adhemar benevolently leading Brazil into the future.

Roll out the red carpet, it's time to celebrate!
strings.BRA_a_humanist_economic_program_desc:
One of the key components of Adhemar's Manifesto in the 1965 Election was his new Humanist Economic Program - the centerpiece of which was to ensure that full employment was achieved in Brazil. No one would be homeless, everyone would have a job, and most importantly it would be a good job.

Adhemar shall begin implementation of this bill through a speech to the senate about his aims. Firstly, a wave of massive infrastructure programs will be rolled out throughout Brazil to support the development of private industry and harness our country's natural resources. Secondly, this would attract large amounts of foreign capital towards Brazil, hopefully causing an economic boom. Finally, harnessing the spirit of Monaco, Las Vegas, and Macau, Brazil would be turned into a hub of finance and gambling, attracting the super-rich to Brazil and replacing Cuba as the hub for American and European clientele in Latin America.

A truly foolproof plan. And through it, this the dream of full employment will have been delivered, and Adhemar will have the people's eternal support!
strings.BRA_barettos_dreams_desc: Although Brazilian President Adhemar de Barros is widely regarded as a well-rounded and very knowledgeable individual, he is in fact fully aware that even a great man such as him can't be an expert on all known subjects. Thus, he knows that he must sometimes rely on the knowledge and ideas of others. Such as his economic advisor, who has ideas about how to strengthen Brazil due to an overall expansion of its oil industry. So far, he has shown Adhemar nothing but his loyalty, so why not allow him to realize his plans? After all, if a decision makes Adhemar and the PSP more popular and electable, how could it ever be wrong?
strings.BRA_and_his_ideas_desc: Although his personal greatness is an undeniable fact known by all in Brazil and the world, President Adhemar is an incredibly humble man. He knows that he can't do everything by himself, so he must sometimes delegate the significant tasks of government to other people. Thus, he has given card Blanche to his economic advisor, Barreto, to start his work on revitalizing Petrobras and the Brazilian oil industry. And he shall do what a particular great friend of Adhemar wanted, take a broom, and start to sweep away the entire... well, most of the corruption by changing directors in Petrobras and increasing salaries, while making his ministry more involved in enforcing ethics of work in the company. The reputation of Brazil's greatest national champion company must not be muddied by corruption and other crimes.
strings.BRA_but_adhemar_knows_the_best_desc: If there is a boss that not only doesn't micromanage his tasks but also has full confidence in all his underlings then that boss is Dr. Adhemar de Barros. But even he must admit that in some crucial matters some supervision from him is needed. Thus, when it comes to the matter of the expansion of Petrobras, Adhemar feels that it is his duty to supervise Minister Barreto's work. So, while his minister will prepare expansion plans, he will make sure all directors are loyal to his administration, after all, it is just fair that Brazil's biggest publicly owned public be loyal to the man and the party that controls its government. And what better way to guarantee the loyalty of the company directors than by giving some ¨gifts¨ and rewards, and what better way to keep their morale high than by visiting them in person and as always promising to keep them happy if they keep the good work for Adhemar and his glorious PSP government!
strings.BRA_national_petrochemistry_desc: No one, absolutely no one is a more knowledgeable person on the matter of the Oil Industry in Brazil than President Dr. Adhemar de Barros. He is truly an expert when it comes to both the strengths and the weaknesses of the Brazilian Oil Industry, especially of its national champion company Petrobras. So, he is fully aware that one of the main issues affecting the company is its processing capabilities. Thus, to increase the efficiency of Petrobras oil processing, his administration shall create Petroquim, a subsidiary of Petrobras, focused on petrochemistry, which should increase the future possibilities of all Brazilian industries that are reliant on chemistry, especially those in need of ethene, which production should be increased thanks to intensification of its conversion from naphtha.
strings.BRA_create_cenpes_desc: President Adhemar isn't the simple dumb country bumpkin some people believe he is. He is much smarter than most people think. He is indeed knowledgeable on many matters of the modern world, and indeed on how day-by-day Scientific Research and Development, RnD, is needed for the Brazilian nation and its many institutions to adapt to the many needs of the modern world. Thus, the Adhemar, Administration has announced the creation of the Centre for Research, Development, and Innovation Leopoldo Américo Miguez de Mello which will be a particular unit of Petrobras, devoted to research, which shall help the company to increase profitability and sustainability thanks to applying the innovative technological solution, which will show that the Adhemar Administration is progressive in all areas!
strings.BRA_technocratic_approach_desc: As time passes so does the flow of information, only with the passage of time the flow becomes more precise and faster. Thus, new data always come that can either refute or reaffirm previous notions. Luckily for Adhemar's Economic Minister the second situation mentioned has become true. For after deep analysis, new data has come to the desk of the economic minister, such data proving that both oil extraction and profitability are slowly yet steadily improving after 1st phase of his plan, this is indeed a great victory for Benedito and proof that he was right with his approach, now Brazil can start to reap benefits of the glorious reforms brought by the Adhemar Administration!
strings.BRA_new_standards_in_petrobras_desc: There is no phrase in the world that is more rewarding to hear than ¨Fait Acompli¨. And no one loves to hear that phrase more than Brazilian President Adhemar de Barros. Thus, with the first phase now completed his government can now use his supremacy in the running of Petrobras to start transferring newly gained money to the PSP's treasure and find someplace in this great company, the most significant national champion in the Brazilian corporate pantheon, for many family members of his great, and most importantly very loyal, party members. With it, he shall cement the PSP's rule in Brazil and make sure his party can count on the support of another branch of government. For no party can govern Brazil better than the glorious PSP!
strings.BRA_start_manufacturing_of_jet_fuel_desc: Brazil's leaders love planes and were the first to massively use them in political campaigns. This of course also includes Dr. Adhemar de Barros himself, after all, Santos Dumont the Father of Aviation was a Brazilian himself. Thus, It is only logical that Brazil should start producing jet fuel domestically to lower prices for it eventually encouraging domestic plane usage. Moreover, it shall be the first move in the direction of domestic aero plane manufacturing! Besides that, we will ensure a small gift for Brazil's Glorious leader President Adhemar. And it shall prove to the Brazilian population once again, that only the PSP and the Adhemar administration can make Brazil rise up to its rightful place amongst the great industrial economies of the world!
strings.BRA_expand_production_of_synthetic_rubbe: During the XIX century rubber boom, the population of western Brazil increased significantly and the rubber itself was a key part of Brazilian exports. No person is more knowledgeable of this aspect of Brazilian History than President Adhemar. He is also aware of what came after, unfortunately, the boom would eventually come to an end with the arrival of the Second World War. However, Adhemar is the kind of man that thinks that it is never too late to try to correct a mistake made by history! Thus, by his logic, if it happened once it certainly can also happen again. However, this time it will be conducted in humane and sterile conditions, not in the wild, full of mosquitos' jungle. The modernization of the Brazilian rubber industry shall serve as proof that only the PSP can lead Brazil on the glorious road toward progress.
strings.BRA_new_refineries_desc: Brazil, thanks to the Adhemar Administration, has walked a long way down the road toward economic progress, and it shall not stop now! Brazil needs oil, the government needs oil, and oil needs Brazil! Thus, the Adhemar administration shall start building refineries in new places to make sure there is no oil deposit left untouched. With this, Brazil shall be closer than ever to achieving complete self-sufficiency in oil. Barreto is happier than ever seeing the progress of his oil program and Adhemar is too, thanks to these successes he shall once again prove that it is he, and not the communists in the PSD-PTB coalition, who is the true heir to Vargas!
strings.BRA_expand_existing_ones_desc: There is nothing in the world that can bring President Adhemar de Barros a bigger smile than seeing the achievements of a job well done. And as he sees the positive results of Benedito's ideas he couldn't be happier. However, he feels that it is time to stop, his government has already spent enough, now according to him it is time to focus on other initiatives, such as those related to welfare, since those result in a higher approval rate amongst the electorate, they are seen as the most important for maintaining the dominance of PSP in Brazil. Thus, at the end of his administration's trip for oil it shall do some small expansion of refineries and for President Adhemar that shall be it, enough of Benedito's dreams.
strings.BRA_pspobras_desc: It is done and let no one deny that it was President Adhemar de Barros and his Glorious PSP government who did it. As everyone can now see data incoming from Petrobras is better than ever, it cannot be denied, the Adhemar administration has achieved big success, another reform that proves that only PSP can truly change Brazil and achieve 50 years of progress in 5, with this Adhemar is now another step closer in direction to assure his re-election of as President and turning Brazil into a truly democratic country, governed by the best party forever and for all!
strings.BRA_the_true_builder_of_brazil_desc: President Adhemar knows that there is still plenty of work to be done to bring all of Brazil into the modern age. Roads need to be paved, factories need to be built, and fields all need to be watered if Brazil wants to be the global power he dreams of. Unlike Kubitschek and Lott who focused on providing for the elites, all of Brazil will be able to enjoy the rewards of Adhemar's bold industrial program. The PSD-PTB coalition is not the true heir to Getúlio Vargas; future generations will know Adhemar de Barros and the PSP as the true builder of Brazil!
strings.BRA_adhemar_connecting_the_nation_desc:
One of the biggest problems currently affecting Brazilian lives all around the country is the lack of infrastructure. While Adhemar has done much to fix it in São Paulo, it is now time to export the Paulista way to the rest of the country and get those roads working.

And what's a better way to show the people our commitment to them than a megaproject! Building a bridge to connect Rio and Niterói; two central cities, so near one another yet so far away, being separated by the Guanabara Bay. But no more will that be a problem, as with the Adhemar Bridge, the first step towards connecting our nation will be complete, showing that Adhemar gets stuff done!
strings.BRA_contacting_foreign_experts_desc:
Getting around the country is much easier said than done, as it currently stands. The varied geography that our cities stand on combined with unchecked sprawl in our lower income areas means that our urban areas are poorly connected to each other. Our rural farms and communities are even more disconnected, leading to serious headaches for our citizens.

The Japanese are no stranger to handling these kinds of issues. Their experts are exactly who we need in order to improve our infrastructure. They will also have plenty of local companies who are willing to invest in our infrastructure projects, which will make Brazil's transport run at newfound efficiencies.
strings.BRA_the_foreign_experiment_desc:
Our urban planners have come up with the idea of developing a metro system in São Paulo, which will connect millions and be a surefire boon to business in the city. There's only one problem: we have no experience constructing metros or subways.

Let us turn to our Japanese friends once more, whose subway systems are among the finest in the world. Their knowledge will be invaluable in assisting our development of the São Paulo metro in making sure that Brazil's first metro network is nothing less than perfect.
strings.BRA_building_up_urban_transport_desc: While some of our most ambitious planners have proposed the São Paulo metro system, some of our more grounded advisors have instead asked us to focus on improving the existing bus and rail networks. Who is to say we cannot focus on both, and transform Brazil's cities into efficient metropolises for all to enjoy. Additional workers and funds will be diverted to our public transport agencies across the country to get Brazil up and running.
strings.BRA_yet_not_forgetting_farmers_desc: If there is one group that does not benefit equally from our country's past industrialization efforts, it would be our farmers. These men and women have been some of our hardest workers, yet previous administrations have seen them as nothing more than troublemakers and complainers. This will not be the case with President Adhemar. He will make sure that their concerns and wishes are heard, so that all of Brazil can prosper together.
strings.BRA_the_great_bridge_builder_desc: Is there anything President Adhemar is incapable of doing? Thanks to him, Brazil is on the move again at breakneck speeds. Bridges are being planned across the country, roads are being paved across rural areas, and the new metro systems have begun to be built. Throughout these times, Adhemar has come in contact with many great businessmen and industrialists throughout Brazil and the world, who have all pledged their willingness to help Brazil move forward. Adhemar will gladly use these connections to make sure that Brazil will be a great and proud country for generations to come!
strings.BRA_continuing_brazils_march_forward_des: Over the past thirty years, Brazil has made great progress in our industrialization campaign. New factories are constantly being opened, producing goods at record efficiencies. However, we cannot afford to sit around and watch our economy stagnate. We must continue marching forward in the name of progress, with Adhemar and the PSP leading the way!
strings.BRA_a_word_with_the_oligarchs_desc: It's certainly no secret that some people in Brazil have more money and influence than others. For our previous presidents, these oligarchs were nothing more than constant annoyances, but President Adhemar knows better than to slight these influential men and women. He will need to be careful in making sure that his efforts to court the oligarchs are legal, but Brazil's potential is endless with their money...
strings.BRA_intensify_steel_production_desc: One of Vargas' primary goals for the Estado Novo was to ensure that Brazil would never need to import steel from a foreign nation. Over the past decade, this goal has faded from both the public's and the previous administrations' eyes, which has set our economy and our military production on a potentially dangerous path. We must make amends for lost time and redouble our efforts to ensure that our country is not dependent on any foreign sources of steel. New steelworks will be built, and additional research in improving production techniques will be authorized.
strings.BRA_hand_in_hand_with_the_protege: Hand in Hand With the Protégé
strings.BRA_hand_in_hand_with_the_protege_desc: Adhemar knows that if the PSP wants to be more than just a blip in Brazil's history, an heir to the party needs to be found. Thankfully, we have an incredible power base in São Paulo, with several young members who are on the up and up. One of them happens to be the son of Getúlio Vargas himself, Getúlio Vargas Jr. The son has already promoted plenty of developmentalist policies in São Paulo, and has a knack for leadership and public speaking. Let's get out to São Paulo, and gladhand a bit with the protégé of the PSP.
strings.BRA_relying_on_old_friends_desc: While the Americans are not a popular bunch within the party, it's hard to deny the amount of investment their companies and government have made in Brazil since the end of the Second World War. In turbulent times at home, it's best if we don't disturb the peace with our foreign policy. We will once again turn to the USA in asking them to assist in our industrialisation programs; if past history is anything to go off of, they'll be more than excited to continue investing in Brazil.
strings.BRA_parlay_with_the_eagle_desc: There's no denying that working with the Germans on literally anything is bound to cause a firestorm. However, there have been decades of opportunities wasted simply because previous administrations refused to even see what the Germans could offer. Ours will not make the same mistake. Hermann Josef Abs, a notorious industrialist and banker in the Reich, has contacted us about allowing his companies to establish a presence in Brazil. We will begin negotiations with him and the Germans, and see what benefits they can provide.
strings.BRA_the_great_developmentalist_desc:
Brazil's streets hum with the sounds of commuters on their way to work and businesses getting ready to open up shop. The trains carry businessmen into the central business districts of our cities, ready to bargain and make deals with countries from around the world. Our farmers have been hard at work even before the sun rises, ensuring that the country stays well fed.

All of this is thanks to the hard work that Adhemar has been able to get done in his time as President. Thanks to his efforts in both the backroom and in the public eye, Brazil is entering a new age of economic development. President Adhemar will join Vargas as one of Brazil's greatest minds.
strings.BRA_a_gesture_of_peace_desc:
Paraguay has been a bit of a thorn in our side, to put it lightly. Their fascist history has made it near impossible for us to work with them on potential projects, let alone open diplomatic channels. However, Adhemar is not going to be so easily dissuaded from working with a potential partner, their domestic politics be damned.

The Paraná River is the continent's second-longest river, and there has been very little done on both our side and Paraguay's side to understand the river's potential if we were to construct a dam. We will direct the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to work with various civil engineers to draft up a proposal for a dam on the Paraná River, in the hopes that Paraguay will also do their due diligence.
strings.BRA_preparing_against_the_foreign_menace:
We offered cooperation and peace, an opportunity for the betterment of relations.

The Paraguayans spat in our faces and rejected our offers.

Adhemar may be many things, but he's not a man who cowers in fear when insulted! Now there are no guarantees that peace will remain a reality in the future, and when peace fails, a nation must make sure it's ready for war, and Brazil sure as hell isn't going to be unprepared for a conflict with Adhemar in charge.
strings.BRA_the_greatest_industry_for_the_greate: The Greatest Industry for the Greatest Army

Adhemar is a great friend to the military! A patriot like nobody else, doing anything to keep Brazil secure from these warmongers who threaten our peaceful nation. In response to this aggression by our neighbors, Adhemar has no choice but to boost military spending and strengthen even more our forces.

The security of our people is of foremost concern; he didn't start this, but he'll be the one to stay on top.
strings.BRA_adhemar_itaipu_dam_over_tt: We have finished negotiating the Itaipu Dam with Paraguay.
strings.BRA_negotiating_the_treaty_of_itaipu_des: Wonderful! Our offer of friendship has been graciously accepted by the Paraguayan government. Now, all we need to do is negotiate the details, with Adhemar taking a leading role in guaranteeing the treaty is fair for Brazil, so we can finally start working on getting more energy to all people of our great country!
strings.BRA_start_the_itaipu_project_desc:
With the agreements finally complete, we can now begin the construction of the Itaipu Dam. And if there is something that will cement Adhemar's legacy, it will be this one.

With the exception of Germany's currently rotting monument to nepotism in the middle of the Congo, it will be the largest hydroelectric power plant on earth. It will provide plenty of electricity to Brazil, for not only will it generate plenty of electricity for us, the Paraguayans will have so much from it they'll have to sell it back to us. Once we have the lines set up all the way to São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, we will have tamed and secured an eternal source of energy for the whole nation. And they will know it was Adhemar who got it done.
strings.BRA_the_great_stateman_desc:
Nobody can deny Adhemar has been an effective leader at home. The vast infrastructure and industrial projects that dot the landscape speak for themselves. But now it's clear, if it wasn't already, he is as big a giant on the international stage as the domestic one. Once again, someone stands up for Brazil's economic interests, instead of bending over for the imperialists.

Where Vargas once stood, standing firm against the German and American eagles, Adhemar holds the line once again. Any deal Brazil will get as long as he's there will be a fair one. Many Brazilian workers can only hear about the foreign capitals of the world. But every Brazilian knows their champion is there, fighting for them every day.
strings.BRA_vargass_true_successor_desc:
When Getúlio Vargas left office, Brazil was once again left adrift. Tossed and turned by a sea of incompetence, with inexperienced captains at the bridge, it was only a matter of time until it would be bashed against the rocks of ruin. The largest nation in South America would have been yet another failure of poverty, imperialism, and radicalism. But finally someone stepped up to take the helm.

Adhemar de Barros was the man who saved Brazil and set it on the right path. Adhemar de Barros is the man who is leading it through these treacherous waters. And Adhemar de Barros will bring Brazil to its rightful destination as a nation of economic strength and social justice.

Vargas led Brazil from the waters of inadequacy. And Barros will bring it to the seas of greatness.
strings.BRA_no_man_left_behind_desc: There are a few economic indicators that can easily tell the general health of a nation's economy, and President Adhemar believes that unemployment is the main scourge of a healthy country. Brazilians who do not work will simply not contribute to the economy, and even worse, be left behind with regards to his other great reforms. Guaranteeing employment not only ensures that Brazilians have stable incomes to depend on, but also gentle reminders of who sourced those jobs would surely build a loyal voter base for the PSP in elections to come. Adhemar will introduce the No Man Left Behind program, a government plan dedicating itself towards solving unemployment in the nation. Both Brazilian and foreign industry will be able to enjoy the influx of labor entering the market, ensuring economic prosperity from the poorest citizens all the way up to the richest industrialists.
strings.BRA_the_cities_of_tomorrow_desc: The sad truth is that today's economies rely heavily on urban production centers to fuel themselves. While Brazil certainly has no shortage of ready labor, men are pouring in from the countryside into slums in our cities, which has driven both a political and economic wedge in our country. This internal migration cannot continue for the good of both rural and urban Brazilians. President Adhemar will invite foreign companies to create company towns throughout rural Brazil to bring economic growth and jobs to the regions, and prosperity to the families living in them. Not only will foreign capital not have to deal with pesky regulations that may exist in our more urban areas, they may find themselves able to pay the rural workers at lower wages than their urban counterparts. Surely everyone wins in this scheme!
strings.BRA_stick_with_our_old_friend_desc: As much as President Adhemar likes to talk of an independent foreign policy, it would be beyond stupid to ignore both the geographical and political advantages of working alongside the United States. The historic relationship between the two nations has only become stronger due to recent events, so there really is no reason to kick the hornet's nest. Besides, their companies are more than capable of supplying the investment needed to fund our grand vision of company towns.
strings.BRA_new_times_new_allegences_desc: Let's face it: if Brazil truly wants to chart its own path into the future, our dependence on American trade is something that cannot continue. President Adhemar is keenly aware of this, and has been focused on improving relations with the German Reich. However, it is time to take that relationship up to a new level. Adhemar will extend an offer to the German industrial conglomerate IG Farben, inviting them to establish company towns throughout Brazil. As always, though, the devil is in the details, and Hermann Josef Abs may not agree to every request of Adhemar...
strings.BRA_forlandia_2_0_desc: The first thing a smart man does when he's trying to solve a problem is to see if anyone else has already solved the problem before. Back in the 20s, the Ford Company established company towns throughout Brazil, trying to source their own rubber to keep input costs down. With our renewed commitments to the Americans, we should ask Ford and other motor companies to take the lead on our renewed company town initiative, given their previous experience. They know of the benefits of establishing these towns first hand, and we can hopefully convince them to persuade other companies to join them in investing in our countryside.
strings.BRA_the_might_of_brazilian_labor_desc: There are many qualities to admire about the Brazilian man, but by and far the most important and valuable quality is their propensity for hard work. Whether they be a rural farmer or a student in one of our great universities, no one in this world can deny the hard working spirit of our citizens. The people themselves know of this, and we will call on them to take up that spirit while enlisting them to work in the company towns. Everyone in Brazil is asked to make sacrifices; President Adhemar has already made many, so now it is the common man's turn to do so.
strings.BRA_ig_farbens_ingenuity_desc: Ever heard of Fordlândia? I bet you haven't, because it was an abject failure by the Ford Company in their attempt to break a stranglehold on the rubber monopoly held by the British at the time. We need no further proof that the American model of capitalism is fundamentally incompatible with Brazil. Instead, let us turn to our newest business partner and give them a fair chance to see what they can do. IG Farben is one of Germany's largest megacorps, focusing primarily on chemical and medicinal projects. Based on Adhemar's discussions with Hermann Josef Abs, their leader, IG already has extensive plans to begin developing company towns throughout Brazil. All they need now is the green light to proceed. Who are we to deny them?
strings.BRA_american_industry_brazilian_markets_: To pretend that we have the technological capacity to rival the major superpowers of the world would be silly. Even President Adhemar can recognize that Brazil has the spirit, but not the technology needed to join their ranks. However, as per part of our agreement with the Americans, we have begun importing their industrial equipment in our company towns. We must dispatch engineers to study the equipment in great depth and see how far we are from constructing our own. After all, we can't depend on the Americans forever.
strings.BRA_german_science_brazilian_resources_d: Brazil has a plethora of natural resources, and those are simply the ones we've already discovered. Who knows what other treasures lie on and under our soil? Unfortunately, government inefficiency and a hostile environment have rendered our extraction capabilities to be mediocre at best. While IG Farben sets up their plants and towns in the countryside, we will need to ensure that the rights to the resources stay with us. Furthermore, we will also take steps to ensure that we do not simply become a resource-oriented export economy. The last thing we can afford is for our economy to be at the whims of foreign partners; no, this will absolutely not do. Instead, our scientists and engineers will work with our German partners in understanding the manufacturing processes so that one day our industrial might will be able to match theirs.
strings.BRA_a_roof_over_their_heads_desc: For most politicians, what comes out of their mouths often does not line up with what is actually delivered to the people. However, President Adhemar is no ordinary politician. Our company towns have accelerated our progress in growing our industry while also providing decent jobs and homes to even Brazil's most destitute. Who cares for what our so-called “partners” from the PTB have to say about the recent surge in heat and workplace-related deaths? Our partners in the corporations have assured us that accidents happen all the time, and it is nothing for us to worry about. We can all thank Adhemar and the PSP for pushing Brazil's people and industry to new heights!
strings.BRA_a_gamblers_paradise_desc:
Brazil has always enjoyed its rightful place as a hub of tourism in South America, with our beautiful beaches and crystalline waters, alongside our lovely cuisine and historical landmarks. That being said, we can surely do much better than allowing the tourists to enjoy a churrascaria and a few photos with Christ Himself. There is no real reason for tourists to return to Brazil once they've enjoyed themselves once.

President Adhemar has just the idea to change Brazil from a trendy little destination into one of the main tourism hubs of the world. There is an untapped market for gaming and gambling in South America. Normally, governments see casinos as nothing more than a front for organized crime, but we will not be so close-minded. Brazil will turn into a gambler's paradise under Adhemar, all the while bringing in jobs and economic activity to the cities that house our new casinos!
strings.BRA_old_money_from_old_europe_desc:
The time has come for Brazil to begin planning the construction of our new casinos, and the issue of money has reared its ugly head. While we could use our own funds to construct the casinos, the timeline would be too long for us to see any benefit. We must look for a foreign partner to aid us in this project.

It is simply not worth asking the United States and their Caribbean partners for this investment. They will likely see our new construction as competition for their own casinos in Vegas, further worsening our relationship with them. Let us instead turn to the Old World and their investors, who are much less likely to see our casino expansion across the Atlantic as a direct threat to their own casinos back home.
strings.BRA_bountiful_cash_from_the_new_world: Bountiful Cash From the New World
strings.BRA_bountiful_cash_from_the_new_world_de:
There is nothing more patently American than the spirit of free and fair competition in a market. That being said, we need to recognize that we are competing against decades of experience in the Americans.

Adhemar himself will head to Las Vegas to begin negotiating with the American casino conglomerates. Rather than trying to shoot for the stars in pretending that our casinos will displace the ones along the Vegas Strip, we should instead extend a hand in cooperation. We will offer them a South American outpost to expand their operations to in exchange for funding to get our casinos up and running at an expedited pace. Much like many of our other projects, Brazil will work with the New World in getting our casinos open for all peoples to enjoy.
strings.BRA_european_experts_desc:
When it comes to gambling, the Europeans are experts without peer. The casinos of Monte Carlo, Bonn, Geneva, and the many other great capitals of the continent have turned profits for gambling barons for decades. And with experience, comes innovation.

It is no secret that these European casinos have developed exciting new ways of providing safe and legal thrills to the masses - as well as cutting quite the generous cheque in return. If were are to partner with these casino barons, then along with cash, we shall bring in this new technology as well.
strings.BRA_modernize_our_casinos_desc:
Brazil is a nation known for many things across the globe. Soft, silky beaches. Sweltering, yet beautiful rainforests. Restaurants filled to the brim with the tastiest food for miles around. A culture that mixes the exoticism of the new world with the familiarity and refinement of the old.

But sadly, it is not yet known for its casinos.

Which is a crying shame to Adhemar, given the potential he sees in the industry. And after all, if there were ever a man to appraise a nation's capacity for grabbing money, it is the President. Thus, his administration will invest in Brazil's casinos - by the time we are through with them, our country will be known as the gambling capital of the world, bar none! A lofty title indeed.
strings.BRA_yankie_entrepeneurs_desc:
As a country built entirely around the enterprising and entrepreneurial spirit, it is no surprise that the Americans reign supreme when it comes to marketing and selling new ways of spending money to the average consumer. While Brazil is no slouch in that department either, our nation lacks a certain spark that the Americans have tapped into.

Adhemar, recognising this, has decided to consult these American financial wizards, so that the Brazilian gambling industry may learn their ways. Soon our great nation will join them on that path paved with gold that they walk.
strings.BRA_a_tropical_monte_carlo_desc:
Every man with even cursory knowledge of gambling worldwide is aware of how much money the city of Monte Carlo pulls in every year. The answer being, a frankly absurd amount, as the European great and good of all stripes and nationalities - or at least, the ones deemed acceptable by the Reich - swagger up to blow their money on poker, slots, and all other manner of games.

Well, who's to say Brazil cannot be a tropical Monte Carlo? The northeast of our nation is very similar in terms of climate to most continental Europe. The more resorts we build up there, the better - it'll be like a home away from home for these rich Europeans. One that is both pleasant and profitable...
strings.BRA_the_southern_las_vegas_desc:
“Viva Las Vegas!” cry the many intoxicated and wealthy Americans who make the pilgrimage west to the City of Sin. Vegas is renowned as “the entertainment capital of the world” across the globe, and should serve as a good model of what Adhemar wants for Brazil.

And, following the Cuban Revolution, we have the opportunity to follow through with this idea. After all, now that the Cubans no longer wish to act as tropical host to the many rich tourists seeking a boozy getaway, it would only make sense for us to step in and fill the vacuum. Come to Brazil! We are, in fact, the Vegas of the South!
strings.BRA_cash_in_our_pockets_desc:
It is done! Once again, Adhemar de Barros has miraculously pulled a rabbit out of a hat and done Brazil a great service. Following the tireless efforts of his administration, Brazil is now one of the biggest resorts and gambling hubs on the planet. This has not only lifted many from poverty by giving them jobs, but has placed plenty of money in our pockets. We aren't going to misuse this money, obviously. That would be unethical. Instead, this money going to the government will be put towards PSP sponsored social programs to ensure these poorer Brazilians stay out of poverty.

Many may decry this as 'buying votes', or claim that Adhemar is doing this to enrich himself, but these people lie. If the people of Brazil feel they owe it to Adhemar and the PSP to vote for him, then it or their business. And the money? Well, if the President makes a little extra on the side, then it's hardly unconstitutional, is it?
strings.BRA_infinite_jobs_infinite_votes_desc:
What many in the UDN and PSD called unachievable has been achieved. The dream of full employment, something which only prosperous economies such as the USA and Japan could reach, has been replicated in Brazil. From the Happy Harbour of Porto Alegre, to Natal, no one has to worry about finding work to feed themselves and their family. The No Man Left Behind program has been a resounding success and PSP media sources promote this fact to the Brazilian people.

Adhemar has done what no other President before him has achieved and has guaranteed the electoral loyalty of many Brazilians towards him and the PSP for decades to come.
strings.BRA_true_progress_desc:
Three years of Adhemar de Barros has single handedly bulldozed through many of the issues Brazil has been facing for years. Corruption? Military inadequacy? Economic woes? You name it, Doctor Adhemar had seen to the problem and diagnosed it as necessary.

Of course, now that Brazil is such a radically different nation, we can only truly accommodate the changing circumstance by modifying the Brazilian constitution as necessary. It was meant as a living document, after all, and far be it from us to deprive Brazil from true prosperity because of something petty such as adhering to updated rules.

And after all, if anybody knows what Brazil needs, it is Adhemar!
strings.BRA_invest_in_amazon_territories_desc: The PSP is always in search of new people to bring its message to - and what better place to look for them than the very depths of the Amazon? The rainforest is a wild and untamed part of our nation - one that, for far too long, has gone ignored and underdeveloped. Well, no more. We shall make it our business to burrow deep into the Amazon and bring our message to these poor, unnoticed people. Lesser men have been content to leave these territories as underdeveloped and ignored as they are for far too long. Fear not, o Amazonians! President Adhemar is here for you!
strings.BRA_invest_in_amazon_territories_tt: This initiative will cover also our newly-annexed territory of Caiena!
strings.BRA_and_make_them_new_states_desc:
We have brought the light of our republic to the Amazon! Hooray! They are now all true citizens of the Republic. Truly, tear-jerking, like watching a child one has known since infancy growing into a strong, self-sufficient man. To commemorate this glorious occasion, we shall turn these territories into full-on states. Already, we have our best men from the PSP drawing electoral boundaries and volunteering to act as senators for the newly-created states.

Elections will not be held immediately, of course. It would be simply impractical to do so. Our men will stay until the next election, wherein the people of these states can decide whether to keep them in power. Is that not the beauty of democracy?
strings.BRA_and_make_them_new_states_tt:
Federal Territories of Amapá, Rondônia, and Roraima shall be reorganized into full-fledged states!
New states will become bastions of the £BRA_psp_texticon PSP!
strings.BRA_and_make_them_new_states_tt_2: Integration of Caiena into Brazil shall be completed with the reorganization into a full-fledged state!
strings.BRA_adhemar_true_promise_cucked_tt: We have begun work on all our agendas.
strings.BRA_adhemar_is_better_than_vargas_desc:
Getúlio Vargas truly was a great man. This is something nobody is denying - we all love Vargas. However, like every great man throughout history, he had his flaws. Vargas could be ruthless towards his enemies - perhaps unduly so. He sent the lover of a communist leader to Nazi Germany. He allowed his political opposition to languish in prison - many of whom are in our very party. And to top it all off, Vargas stood side by side with the military in the Constitutionalist Revolution, while Adhemar opposed him alongside the Paulistas.

We know that Vargas was good— but Adhemar is great! And it is only right that we let everybody know. Interviews, books, pamphlets - whatever it takes. The truth will get out.
strings.BRA_adhemar_five_more_years_tt: Nelson Gonçalves will prepare a new jingle for the presidential campaign!
strings.BRA_adhemar_five_more_years_desc: Everyone loves Adhemar. Even people who do not know they love Adhemar yet love Adhemar - he is truly beloved nationwide. By popular demand, we have no choice other than to begin preparations for his re-election campaign. Thankfully, Congress has not yet passed anything to prevent an incumbent President from planning his re-election, so we are well within our legal rights to do so! Roll out the posters, roll out the red carpet, Adhemar is on the trail again! Say, where is Nelson Gonçalves? We will need a catchy jingle or slogan to go along with the campaign, after all...
strings.BRA_tax_reform_desc: One of Adhemar's original promises when campaigning for President was that one blessed day, salary and income would be synonyms, rather than different entities. Thankfully, we live in an era where the Brazilian people have chosen the sane, stable option, and by God did they make the right choice! The introduction of a new, more progressive taxation system will provide nearly total tax exemptions for the poorest amongst us, and increase the stream of money to states and municipalities by redirecting the taxes to the middle and upper classes. This is how people who know damn well what to do get the money they need - on a local and national level, this is only a prelude to a better Brazil - one united by Adhemar de Barros and the PSP!
strings.BRA_coffee_blood: Coffee, the Blood of the Nation
strings.BRA_coffee_blood_desc: What honest, hardworking man doesn't start the day with a good old cup of coffee? It is the lifeblood of our nation. This is something Adhemar knows all too well. But as well as the coffee itself, he recognises that the men and women who slave away day and night to gather it are just as central to the economy. Without them, the money would dry up quickly, and so Adhemar intends to show them the gratitude they deserve. With loans from the central government, coffee co-ops will be set up, so that these workers can sell and store the crop on their own, saving the both of us money and taking the government well away from the market - where it should be.
strings.BRA_new_parliament_tt: Adhemar will discuss the issue with leaders of our relevant profession.
strings.BRA_new_parliament_desc: In every nation, there always ends up being groups that are more important than others. It is an inevitability. Many countries try to ignore them - preferring to keep such meetings and deals obscured in shadow, away from the eyes of the people. Here in Brazil, we do not hang our heads in shame at such a thing. Instead of ignoring them like a bad smell, we shall make anyone with a large enough base of support feel as welcome in building Brazil's future as the President himself. This is not just a normal democracy - this is a true, new democracy. A true parliament of equals. It will be difficult to decide who to allow in first, however. Should it be the trade unions, or the army?
strings.BRA_are_illiterates_trustworthy_tt: Adhemar will discuss the issue with party leaders.
strings.BRA_are_illiterates_trustworthy_desc:
How many people cannot read in Brazil? Far too high a number, certainly. However, this should NOT mitigate their right to take part in the democratic process. They are people too, and deserve a fair say in the future of Brazil. And Adhemar de Barros will fight to ensure they have the power to do so! He is the champion of these people, and always will be - who is to say that they will not return the favor come election time?

Sadly, many in the PSP do not see this logic. These party men fear that the newly-inducted voters will instantly gravitate towards the PTB. This issue is causing much turmoil. And as usual, there is only one man who can resolve the issue. Adhemar.
strings.BRA_organic_constitution_tt: Even if God starts the Final Judgment, Congress will pass amendments to Constitution.
strings.BRA_organic_constitution_desc:
Vargas made many mistakes. This is an inalienable fact of political life in Brazil. In his infinite wisdom, however, Adhemar de Barros can look past this. While he may never say it openly, he truly admires Vargas - his connection to the people, his political acumen, and his willingness to lead Brazil in times of turmoil.

The one area in which he looks down upon the man, however, was leaving himself vulnerable. Vargas could not ensure that he and his party could remain in power as long as was needed to get the job done, and that was his undoing. And with the set of constitutional amendments Adhemar is set to push forwards into Congress, he will avoid this mistake, proving himself greater than Vargas could have dreamt.
strings.BRA_moral_and_beautiful_country_tt: {bra_getnamewithflag} is a democracy in name but anything else...
strings.BRA_moral_and_beautiful_country_desc:
A new dawn has risen upon our beautiful country - one of peace, freedom, and strength. Many claim that the only change we have brought upon Brazil is selfish and venal; that Adhemar has fed the nation from a poison chalice. But regardless of the thoughts of pessimists and plebeians, the thoughts of the people are clear; the PSP has well and truly proven itself as the party of Brazil.

5, 10, 15, 20 more years. However many more years we are in power, it does not matter. The party is Brazil incarnate. The PSP will remain in power as long as it takes to deliver on the mandate granted by the Brazilian people to guide them forward.

If that is forever, then so be it.
strings.BRA_puppetmaster_is_out_desc:
Adhemar de Barros has slipped into a coma, and has shown no signs of waking from it soon. While he sleeps, our government has been immobilized by crippling fear and confusion. The same cannot be said of our enemies.

The opposition has submitted a bill to Senado, introducing articles of impeachment, and the PSP is in no shape to mount a serious opposition to them. There is no doubt that quick action must be taken in order to bring Brazil out of the chaos that is consuming it whole.

The only question is who will be the ones to lead the nation out of this crisis?
strings.BRA_but_his_legacy_will_be_continued_des:
Last we checked, our party still holds many seats and levers of power throughout the current government. So what if Adhemar is unable to govern in his current state. We need to pick up the slack, right now, and get to work.

We need to hit the ground running right now to ensure that Adhemar will still have a presidency to return to when he recovers. Everyone in the PSP owes the President that much, at least, even if we all don't agree with every action and every bill that has been passed. The last thing we can afford right now is for those opposition jackals to steal the presidency from us in this time of unrest, and for them to start poking their noses into business they don't belong in.

Our war chest has been diminished, but it is far from empty. If Neves wants to introduce the articles of impeachment to the Senado, let him. We still have some tricks up our sleeves. We'll start introducing some briefcases filled to the brim with cruzeiros to our fellow countrymen. Let's see how their tune changes then about our President!
strings.BRA_but_his_legacy_will_be_continued_req: Laudo Natel shall save £BRA_psp_texticon PSP, because nobody else can...
strings.BRA_maintain_unity_of_psp_desc:
Adhemar's coma has sent the party into a complete nosedive. While PSP centrists are still willing to back Natel and the party, the two ideological wings of the party have completely fallen apart.

Romeu de Campos Vergal is leading the PSP's left in calling for additional agrarian reform and direct investment in local businesses in order to combat foreign capital from pushing Brazilians out of hardworking jobs. Meanwhile, João Café Filho on our right flank has called for austerity via cutting social spending, pointing to the ballooning national debt as a ticking time bomb.

Natel is going to have to choose a side between the two, if he has any hope of getting enough votes and keeping the party image. And it won't just be the PSP who notices who he sides with; the other parties will also notice the shift in policy, and perhaps have their own opinions on it...
strings.BRA_call_auro_desc:
You would think that the leader of the Senado being a member of the PSD would spell certain doom for both Adhemar and the PSP, given the current situation.

You'd be thinking completely wrong.

Enter Auro de Moura Andrade, Senator from São Paulo. The son of a cattle baron with a certain knack for politics. Everyone hates his guts, but no one denies his ability to get things done. Officially a member of the PSD, but certainly willing to work with anyone who has the cash. And if there's one thing the PSP doesn't lack, it's bribe money.

Let's make a call to the good Senator, and ask him to postpone the vote on impeachment as a little favor. We're going to need more than just a couple of briefcases stuffed with cash for this stunt, but if it means keeping Adhemar and the PSP in power, so be it. No one said that maintaining the presidency would be cheap.
strings.BRA_truce_with_lacerda_desc:
Carlos Lacerda and the UDN are the entire reason that we are stuck in this goddamn mess. The ratbird from Guanabara has been a constant thorn in our side since Adhemar has gotten elected. As much as we may hate each other's guts, there is a bigger boogeyman in the room that we can use against Lacerda.

We just need to plant the idea that if Adhemar gets impeached, the PSD-PTB coalition will be the ones on top, and not Lacerda's UDN. And if that happens, Brazil is going to return to Varguist policies thanks to a cabinet filled with leftists. If there's one person that Lacerda absolutely hates more than us, it's Getúlio Vargas.

Let's see how this little crow caws when we mention Vargas' name. Cover your ears, gentlemen.
strings.BRA_hail_to_the_heir_desc:
São Paulo is the birthplace of the PSP and Adhemar's career. It is a city of opportunities, a city of chance, and more importantly, a PSP stronghold. If São Paulo falls, then the PSP is truly lost.

Since Adhemar's ascension to the presidency, one man in particular has made his impact felt throughout the party. No one expected it to be the son of Getúlio Vargas himself, but he has been a key member of our party since his election, and he has assumed Adhemar's role in São Paulo as the main PSP powerbroker in the region.

We need to hold onto São Paulo at all costs. A quick chat with Getúlio Vargas Jr. is in order.
strings.BRA_calm_the_hell_down_desc:
Despite our best efforts, the nation continues to collapse in on itself. Protests are becoming more frequent by the day. Smooth-talking politicians continue to mislead the public against us, which only makes the protests devolve into riots. Something needs to be done, and it needs to get done quick.

The PSP has always been a party that is focused on maintaining law and justice, leaving no one behind. Reminding the people of that should calm a lot of them down, and ensure that order returns to the streets. The real question is what to do about the circus ringleaders that continue to rile the good men and women of Brazil against us.
strings.BRA_bribe_the_press_desc:
For some reason, newspapers throughout our country have begun writing stories filled with nonsense. “President on his deathbed?” and “Collapse of the PSP?” are somehow getting the green light from editors and publishers to go out on the front page of the papers.

Now is a good time to pay a visit, personally, to a few of these publications. Just to remind them that the PSP have always been their most ardent supporters, and that we, much like the rest of them, are dedicated towards publishing the truth and only the truth. We'll also slip in a gentle reminder that if it wasn't for our payroll, there wouldn't be a single functioning newspaper in Brazil. With how much we're “investing” into the free press, who could say that the PSP does not stand with the Brazilian people?
strings.BRA_utilize_kruels_connections_desc: If you're a Brazilian President, and you want to stay in power, you better have the military on your side. We need to make sure of this, now more than ever, especially since our Minister of the Army has suddenly gone missing. Amaury Kruel is hardly a popular person, but he still holds significant sway within Brazil's armed forces. Getting him on our side will ensure that the military is pacified for the time being. It might not be cheap, but it'll consolidate our power in the country.
strings.BRA_communist_hydra_desc:
We're in the goddamn shit now, boys. The impeachment vote is just around the corner, and we do not have the votes to stop it from going through currently. None of the major parties are willing to listen to us, and everyone that we could've bribed has already taken our money. Time to take a massive risk.

Remember the PCB? The grand party of the 20s and 30s, right before Vargas brought down the hammer and crushed them into dust? Well, as much as we'd prefer not to talk about it, Adhemar has some connections to them. After the fall of the Estado Novo, Adhemar went around to the few PCB politicians who remained and got them onto our side. Of course, the party was almost immediately banned again, and we purged them out of São Paulo.
strings.BRA_men_of_sigma_desc:
Everyone has their dirty laundry. We've probably got a lot more than most people, but there are still some secrets that we hope no one ever finds out. When the PSP was founded, it was a political union between the Partido Republicano Progressista and Miguel Reale's Partido Popular Sindicalista, or PPS. The PPS' ranks were filled with ardent integralists, some of whom had several ugly ties to fascism. Thanks to Adhemar's political savvy, those ties never surfaced in the public light. But we cannot deny that they were a part of our past.

The current crisis mandates that we look to every corner of Brazil for support in our efforts to see Adhemar stay on the presidential throne. And with support across the mainstream parties all but dried up, there's only one group left to turn to. Time to make a call.
strings.BRA_and_the_changes_are_on_the_way_desc:
Adhemar's rule has seen the tendrils of corruption tighten faster around Brazil. We must act quickly if we are to end his kakistocracy and restore constitutional reality. The ringleader himself is fading away, and his circus of cronies is directionless. Edna Lott has worked tirelessly tugging against Adhemar's corruption, and now is the time to put an end to it.

To stop the constitutional confusion, Adhemar must be impeached! A mindless husk cannot rule a country. This will require Edna's finest negotiating skills to wrangle congress into safely passing the bill. But she feels confident in her ability to do so. Now is the time to act - democracy is at stake!“
strings.BRA_and_the_changes_are_on_the_way_req_t: It is time to restore President Vargas' legacies.
strings.BRA_the_greatest_friend_desc: Edna's obvious first move is to secure the backing of her party. In Brazil, this is never so simple - The PTB is a party with many wings, but it would be best to begin negotiating with the parties' left - Grupo Compacto. Led by Leonel Brizola. The two laborists should easily see eye to eye, recognising their common enemy in the flailing PSP. With many connections, particularly in the party's youth and the State of Rio Grande do Sul. Securing her base will allow Edna to focus on reaching out to the rest of congress and ridding the presidency of Adhemar's rotting corpse.
strings.BRA_democratic_coalition_desc:
Adhemar's fierce pragmatism may have rubbed off on Edna - in order to rid Brazil of him, she needs the support of the rest of Congress, namely, the UDN, the party that poses the greatest threat to Varguism and is a fierce opponent of laborism. Led by Carlos Lacerda, the UDN must be swayed to ensure Edna's succession. Lacerda's Amerophilia and hatred of the Reich could be used to gain his favor if Edna were to commit her presidency's foreign policy to aligning with the OFN and severing all ties with the Einheitspakt.

Whether our dealings will convince the most virulent hater of Varguism to side with us is unclear, but stranger bedfellows have been made in Brazilian politics before.
strings.BRA_divide_et_impera_desc:
Adhemar was the glue that held the PSP together - his corruption spread like a cancer through the party, and much of what is left is now beyond salvation. But buried in this pile of cronyism lie some fragments of a progressive movement, fools swept up by Adhemar's charisma and supposed ability to get things done. The party's leftist clique, led by Romeu de Campos Vergal, is one such piece - with assurances from Edna, some members of the party may jump ship from the sinking PSP, and if they do, they'll be welcomed with open arms into the PTB.

Together with our new former PSP allies, we can achieve a truly progressive Brazil, with all the social legislation Adhemar passed - but without his entrenched corruption.
strings.BRA_varguists_stand_together_desc: Juscelino Kubitschek and Henrique Lott, the PSD and the PTB - both governed the country together for a time, a coalition of two firmly Varguist parties against the UDN. Edna built many relationships between these parties in that time, particularly because of her father's role as President. Tancredo Neves, Ulysses and Kubitschek have been Edna's allies within the PSD for a long time - their support is necessary to ensure both our success and the fate of the whole of Brazil.
strings.BRA_nationwide_rallies_desc:
While Edna lacks the power of the military, or the corrupt institutions that Adhemar has procured, she and the PTB wield something perhaps more powerful - labor! Trade unions and peasant leagues make up much of the party's support base, and we can leverage this power to ensure that congress and Adhemar's supporters get the message. Strikes, protests and riots - all are on the table to ensure the end of the PSP's rule.

Edna will embark on a tour throughout Brazil, motivating the people to express their support, ensuring her legitimacy as the incoming President. Alongside Brizola and Jango, they will spread the message of prosperity for all!
strings.BRA_help_of_the_mad_man_desc:
It was on a campaign to secure São Paulo that Adhemar, puffing himself up, stated that no matter how many of the new sanitariums he built, none would be efficient enough to hold someone as insane as Jânio Quadros. Hitting back, Quadros made a speech retorting that no matter how many prisons he built, none would be big enough to hold a criminal as fat as him. This exchange entirely surmises the bitter rivalry between the two men.

If we are to secure the anti-Adhemar coalition, then we need to enlist the help of those who utterly despise the man - and there are few men in Brazilian politics who hold such burning hatred towards Adhemar as Quadros. While the man may certainly be a scatterbrained eccentric, he has fire; the exact kind of fire we need right now, hence why we shall convince him to make a speech condemning the Adhemar presidency - if he can afford to take the time away from his busy schedule of admiring paintings, of course.
strings.BRA_reach_to_constitutionalists_desc:
The military in Brazil - hell, in all of South America - has always been a capricious beast. Getting their support has always been a coin toss - perhaps they will allow a democratically elected government to continue governing, or perhaps they won't.

We are no different, thus we must ensure they are on our side. Thankfully, Edna should have a somewhat easier time than most, given the power that her last name bears. All that it would take to at least reduce the concern of a military coup is a phone call to her father Henrique Teixeira Lott to drum up support amongst the PSD and the constitutionalist cliques. It's been a while since she has spoken to her father, anyway.
strings.BRA_attempt_to_delegalise_psp_desc:
There is something rotten in the state of Brazil - a cancer eating away at the foundations of our democracy and sovereignty. And that cancer is named the PSP. They masquerade as a grassroots arm of the people, simply out to look out for the people's best interests. This could not be further from the truth.

They are gangsters! Mafia men! A collection of seedy criminals and German puppets who would turn the government into a glorified protection racket, whilst permanently tethering Brazil's people to the Reich! They have been allowed to operate unhindered for far too long, and we shall not tolerate this anymore.

With the opportunities presented to Edna, the duplicitous nature of this group shall be brought to public attention. Hopefully this will speed up their collapse - and good riddance, too.
strings.BRA_to_continue_the_legacy_of_vargas_kub:
The PSP has one of the strongest propaganda mills in the country - that is something even we can freely admit. It is a monolith, churning out paper after paper lauding Adhemar for his supposed accomplishments out on the daily. However, it has ground to a halt. As the PSP machine runs around like a headless chicken, we have an opportunity to supplant it.

We shall launch a press campaign in Última Hora that lauds Edna as the latest successor of a dynasty of Brazilian political thought. The progressivism of Vargas, the optimism of JK, and the legalistic worldview of Lott all rolled into one package, ready to take Brazil away from the seediness of the Adhemar presidency and into the future!
strings.BRA_ask_gordon_for_help_desc:
It would be downright idiotic to not look to the United States for help in backing our chosen side. We aren't so different; Brazil and America, two former colonies that, having been on the same losing side in the Second World War, have forged bonds stronger than steel. They are our neighbors and friends.

Help from the Ianques won't just help get members of the UDN on board, but it will give the President (whoever that may be) enough time to help pay off the gargantuan amount of debt that we find ourselves saddled with - and God knows that they will need it.
strings.BRA_an_unlikely_candidate_desc:
Throughout the Adhemar presidency, the Germans have been slowly but surely sinking their tendrils into Brazil. It started off slow - some money here and there, a few investors coming in, and so on. But now, their involvement has come to a boiling point, thus dropping us into the shitshow we currently find ourselves.

Many think that Laudo Natel would have to be an idiot to seek the support of the Germans knowing all this. But he is desperate for votes. Adhemar's legitimacy dwindles by the day and the smaller the vote margin, the worse off the PSP will be. And if that takes making a deal with the devil, then to hell he will go.
strings.BRA_one_last_push_desc:
It's very early in the morning. Everybody is exhausted. A hurried clerk at the Senator's office frantically takes calls from those on both sides of the impeachment vote, trying to buy his employer's vote. A cup of coffee has gone cold on a small table in the Plantaldo, as doctors and nurses keep watch over the President. The entire country is hushed, sitting in front of their televisions.

The hour of judgment is nigh.

The stakes are high. The fate of the past half a decade's worth of progress made by the Adhemar presidency is up in the air. The Varguists stand ready at the gates, ready to seize any chance they have to banish the PSP to the depths of hell as the Social Progressive batter down the hatches.

Into the arms of democracy we go.
strings.BRA_adhemar_comatree_one_last_push_toolt: It all comes down to this. The vote will begin.
strings.BRA_against_all_odds_desc:
Adhemar Lives!

Many have tried to take Adhemar down; the establishment, the heartless conservatives, and the false Varguists have all taken their turn trying to ruin him and each time they have been left wanting. Even when death itself took a swing at Adhemar, he found it too hard to take down our great leader. Yet this was not just Adhemar's victory, we must pay tribute to the loyal countrymen who fought to keep the government of the people in power.
Now with our opponents dealt with, we must now move to deal with restoring confidence in the government. The crisis of the past year has left the future of the PSP as uncertain, and it is up to us to prove we are truly the only party that delivers.
strings.BRA_remove_the_viper_desc:
Edna Lott betrayed the Brazilian people. She, in her deluded attempts to defy the will of people, have conspired from the start to overthrow us. When we were at our weakest, she attempted to impeach us and take the Presidency for herself. She is nothing more than an enemy of the Brazilian people, a tyrant no better than a military dictator.

Luckily it seems like her failure has crushed her spirit and she will be returning to Rio for the rest of this term. When she leaves for Rio we will remove all of her allies in the administration. The Brazilian people deserve better than a traitorous wench in their government. They deserve a full PSP government, filled with people who put their interests first, no matter the circumstances.
strings.BRA_cohabitation_desc:
Politics make strange bedfellows. One of the few failures of 65 was our inability to get our great ally Laudo elected as VP. In his place, came the daughter of the man who had stolen the presidency from us in 1960. It is no secret that Edna Lott resented having to work with us, and our conflicting methods in governance have acted as a permanent thorn in relations between Adhemar and Edna.

Thus, when our administration was at its lowest moment, and our enemies attempted to impeach Adhemar, it came as a massive shock when Lott refused to aid them in their coup attempt. Perhaps then, the best way to solve this mystery is to go and ask her directly.
strings.BRA_friendship_end_usa_desc:
What has America ever done for us?

This is a question Adhemar has been pondering for years now. What has America ever been to our country but pointless wars and constant interference? America is nothing more than a parasite, a self-appointed dictator of the Americas, attempting to push their will on the free people of Brazil. Their most obvious assault on Brazil has come and gone, their attempt to overthrow us through delivering Lacerda information about Adhemar's secretary and then supporting our opposition when they tried to impeach us failing miserably.

We are not an American colony. Gone is the time when they can push us around without consequence, there will be consequences for their misdeeds. Leaving the OFN and removing American bases in the North should send a suitable message.
strings.BRA_man_who_deceived_us_desc:
Adhemar is a good natured, honest man who tries to see the best in people, even if they give him reasons to mistrust them. When Hermann Josef Abs offered to restart German-Brazilian relations and kickstart trade, Adhemar took him up on his lucrative deal in spite of the former's dubious nature. He should've trusted his gut. Along with his own secretary, Abs conspired to transform Brazil into another Reichskommissariat. To repay them with their betrayal, we will make sure to expel all traces of German influence in Brazil!

We will not only ban all trade connections with the Pakt and nationalise German trade assets, but also break off diplomatic ties with them and extradite Germans diplomats and “spies” from Brazil. While we seek get rid of everything German, we are not genocidal monsters like them. In that regard, German-Brazilians are free to stay as they have a long history here and are law-abiding citizens.

Abs thought he could make a fool of us, let us show him how wrong he was.
strings.BRA_just_pass_it_desc:
Brazil is an independent power. Adhemar assumed that fact to be known by all superpowers wo do business with us, but it seems that great powers have a tendency to overstep their bounds, well no more, this so called superpower has caused great suffering to our nation and helped launch Brazil into the crisis that has rocked us for the past few months. At last, we will make them pay for crossing us.

Unfortunately, the voting process is taking longer than expected. To speed up the process, we shall use certain donations to encourage our colleges to see the validity of our bill. Adhemar just wants this chapter of his presidency closed, so he can move back to normal politics. The 1970 election is closing in, and Adhemar's succession must be decided.
strings.BRA_now_germany_best_friend_desc:
Perhaps the greatest foreign policy mistake of the past 30 years has been our foolish antagonism towards Germany. We have fought time and time again against this supposed menace and for what? Are we any richer, are our people any more respected on the world stage? No, for too long, we have acted as an American stooge but no longer. With our rejection of America, our fine German friends will come to take their place.

While it will be many years until we become full Pakt members, Abs connection's will enable us to easily expand our connections within the Unity Pakt and regain the GDP growth that was damaged by American withdrawal. Within time, Brazil will find prosperity away from the American gaze and find our independence standing alongside the German Eagle.
strings.BRA_adhemar_germania_visit: President Adhemar will go on a grand tour to Germania and cement ties between Brazil and Germany.
strings.BRA_quadros_was_always_right_desc:
Quadros is a fucking idiot. A fool, who prattles on about 'corruption' while lining his own pockets. Even Adhemar could not build enough hospitals to deal with his mental issues, yet even a broken clock is right twice a day. Brazil is destined to be a superpower, and a superpower does not dance to the whims of other nations, it is a truly independent power. Quadros was thus right to seek out an independent foreign policy, and Adhemar will make this idea a reality.

With Germany out of the picture, we need to reorient our diplomacy to encourage both Sphere and OFN investments here. This will lead to them fighting each other for influence with an increased number of investments, which will be only beneficial to us. With this tactic, Brazil will truly be able to become an independent power.
strings.BRA_problem_of_prestes_desc:
Adhemar's time in a coma was perhaps both the PSP and modern Brazil's darkest hour. It was full of many necessary compromises and conflicts, all needed to keep Brazil safe and prosperous. Yet some actions taken during the crisis go beyond what is politically necessary and creep into foolishness.

Laudo's agreement to legalize is one such action, and a move too far for Adhemar. To personally solve this, Adhemar will personally call up Carlo Prestes to somehow find a solution that won't blow up in our face. If we can get past this without being called a traitor, Adhemar may be able to sleep peacefully.
strings.BRA_salgados_inauguration_desc:
The recent Coma crisis brought some of the worst figures in Brazilian politics out of the woodworks. One such unpleasant figure we had to compromise with was the famed, hated Plínio Salgado, the leader of the Integralists. In exchange for Reale's support, we promised to appoint Plínio Salgado as minister of education.

This controversial decision was of course necessary for the health of the Republic yet this has brought with it many headaches. This will perhaps be harmful for our public appearance, but Adhemar never forgets his debts. All we can do now is make sure the new government understands the new situation and stays loyal to the government.
strings.BRA_preparation_for_seventy_desc:
At last, with the immediate problems dealt with, we can begin preparation for the next election. As the first convention without Adhemar as the Presidential candidate, this is sure to be a momentous occasion. While this will be the first convention where not Adhemar will play the first violin, he is sure to be a key participant, making sure the party does not choose... poorly.

We have proven to the people we are a party of effective governance, we must now show we do not rely on the charisma of one man, that we are the only party who can take Brazil through the coming years of turmoil. It is a long road to the election, yet we cannot be idle, we must win a clear majority over the opposition, to prove we are the true voice of the Brazilian people.
strings.BRA_adhemar_ozymandias_desc:
It wasn't just a scrape, but a date with death. Adhemar is lucky to be alive - one incompetent hospital worker and his life's work, no, his legacy, would have been stolen from him. We cannot control his health, but we can control his readiness, and make sure that he leaves the executive function ready for someone to finish what he started.

This President has done so much for this country, even if his people did not recognize the burden he took for them. He deserves to be remembered for his service, his effectiveness, his cunning and his power. He deserves to be remembered as a President greater than Lott, Kubitschek, or Vargas... no, more than that. He will be remembered as the greatest President of all time!
strings.BRA_no_bridge_too_far_desc:
If brushing against probable demise does not awaken Adhemar's instinct to build a legacy, everyone will take him for a fool. Although not a cheap or even effective method, monuments can be an effective propaganda tool. From the Egyptian Pyramids to the Statue of Liberty in New York, people love spectacles, and Adhemar will provide them with just that. Practicality be damned, for he has not much longer to make his worth clear.

Brasília will work as quickly as conceivable to pump out aggressively promoted megaprojects, some of which sorely needed public works and others less than mandatory. Either way, everyone will witness the results and be dazzled for a moment — the Progressistas in the army, renowned as a decent lot, will surely be eager to aid in these ambitions. No one can be upset about highways getting built, so why would there be any protests?
strings.BRA_fulfill_nikke_promise: Fulfill the Promise to the Nikkei
strings.BRA_fulfill_nikke_promise_desc:
Among all those empty words Adhemar promised his Japanese partners, he should at least show a modicum of honor by providing a token gesture to symbolize this newfound friendship at a local level. With the Japanese immigration rate stagnating for a long while and its origin borne from a racist theology, there is no reason for the long-standing immigration ban to continue. Solely on account of moral decency, Adhemar would be willing to phase out the exclusionary policy without outside urging. But popular demand turns out to align with the president's foresight.

A good business backer of Brazil is a respectable friend of Adhemar. The Nikkei will be able to reunite with their families as a reward for their long-standing loyalty to the establishment. Let the Nikkei lobbyists know before all else that Adhemar is a true 'tomodachi.'
strings.BRA_healthcare_revolution_desc:
Not a single Brazilian deserves to lead a poor quality of life just because they are deprived of the most basic necessity of medicines. Without the good doctor, Adhemar would be six feet under now. If the President himself, with access to the finest services across the country, can fall terminally ill without warning, then what of those who cannot sustain themselves with three square meals? Of course, the pitifully poor lads in Guanabara slums will never be as valuable as Adhemar on their own, but it would be grave inhumanity to let them rot when everyone knows they don't have to.

In what better way can Adhemar show thanks to the Lord's mercy than paying for Brazil's fledgling public health industry? Since most funds nowadays are tied to labyrinthine directives, if some fats get trimmed off miscellaneous parts, who would object to it when hospitals operate like well-oiled machines?
strings.BRA_adhemar_a_new_dawn_desc:
As President Adhemar de Barros' health improves, so, too, does the mood in our beautiful nation and with our people; they, too, feel as he does and feel our country's growth financially and internationally. These sentiments are not based on fantasy, either. There have been growing pains along the way, but the President and his staff at the Planalto Palace alike accept their contribution, and Brazil has not suffered as much as it has succeeded in these past few years.

For the Presidency, it is a time of recognition. The people's vote for Adhemar was a call for something different, and this desire was most certainly answered. With every day, he is all the more certain that his service to Brazil has been to its benefit. It is about time that others said so as well.
strings.BRA_bribe_tv_globo_desc:
The free press is to be respected, that much is obvious; however, as of late, the greedy muckrakers at TV Globo have seen fit to levy insult after insult, illuminating so-called truths that Brazil would be better off without knowledge of.

This cannot stand, and thankfully, we need not allow it to. There remain those in the corporation who remember its days of journalistic integrity, and there remains plenty of funds in our pockets.
